tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud 'chad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag la nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung la chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can gyi ma dpe tshig sna ring thung sogs cung zad mi 'dra ba gsum la sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis 'dra bsdur zhus dag bgyis pa'i legs par bshad pa blo gsal mig thur zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /maṅga laṃ// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gsung dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /zin bris 'dra min zhus dag legs bgyis pa/ /legs bshad blo gsal mig thur bshad kyis nyon/ /ces mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas te nyan par gdams nas/ 'dir dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud 'chad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag la nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad rdo rje 'chang gi gsung la chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can gyi ma dpe tshig sna ring thung sogs cung zad mi 'dra ba gsum la phan tshun 'dra bsdur gyi sgo nas zhus dag bgyis pa'i legs par bshad pa blo gsal mig thur zhes bya ba bshad par bya ba ni 'di ltar/ oṃ swa sti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud 'chad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba rgyud sde spyi yi rnam gzhag mdo tsam brjod na/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ kyai rdo rje'i tshig don gyi cha rnams yin la/ de 'chad byed kyi man ngag ji tsam byung dpyad pa/ de rnams kyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i lugs ngos bzung ba'o/ /dang po ni rtsa ba'i rgyud 'di tshig brling zhing gyong ba/ 'chad byed kyi man ngag med par 'chad mi nus shing / 'chad byed kyi man ngag rigs mi 'dra ba rnams kyang phan tshun ma 'dres par so sor shes dgos te/

ma shes na de rnams phan tshun 'chol bar 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /de la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bshad srol ji tsam byung dpyad pa/ de nyid bod kha ba can du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la byang chub sems dpa'i rdo rje snying po'i 'grel pa sogs bcu gnyis tsam byung ba las/ rdo rje snying 'grel la/ stod 'grel dang / smad 'grel gnyis su grags pa las/ dang po ni le'u lnga pa yan te rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni le'u drug pa man chad kyi 'grel pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dus 'khor rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bka' ma yin zhing / sems 'grel skor gsum byang sems kyis byas pa min zer ba ma gtogs gzhan phal che bas tshad mar khas len no/ /gnyis pa ni/ snga rabs pa rnams na re/ gang phyir bcu drug cha med pas/ /'bad pas kun gyi lhag ma spangs/ /zhes pa'i bshad pa dus 'khor dang mi mthun pa'i phyir/ rdo rje snying pos byas pa min zer ba ni don la gnas te/ smad 'grel mdzad mkhan de nyid rdo rje snying po dang mtshan gcig pa yin nam/ gang ltar yang rtsa rgyud gzigs pa'i paṇḍi ta gcig yin gyis/ stod 'grel mdzad mkhan dang mi gcig ste/ de dang grub mtha' mi mthun pa du ma snang zhing / stod 'grel du rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa'i don de nyid le'u lnga pa yan chad du bsdus nas 'chad ces dam bcas kyis/ le'u drug pa man chad kyi 'grel pa byed ces ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la stod 'grel la/ pu hrang lo chung grags 'byor shes rab dang / smad 'grel la 'bro dge slong shes rab grags kyi 'gyur yod do/ /stod 'grel gyi bshad srol rje btsun gong ma rnams la pu hrang lo chung nas brgyud pa yin zhing / dus 'khor gyi bshad srol yang de nas brgyud pa yin te/ rje sa chen gyis pu hrang lo chung dang / des mdzod kyi 'grel bshad mdzad mkhan slob dpon rgyal pos sras dang / des dus zhabs pa chung ba la gsan pa yin no/

/yang dka' 'grel padma can zhes pa yod de/ de ni dang por yar lung pa khu dngos grub 'byung gnas la brgyud nas/ dbang bka' dang bshad bka' la sogs pa byung yang / da lta 'gyur tsam lus so/ /rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la dbang bka' dang 'grel pa'i lung dang / lam skor dgu'i nang gi padma ba'i lam zhes pa yod de/ yang slob dpon padma'i myu gus byas pa'i dka' 'grel yod de/ slob dpon de yang spyi dang mu stegs byed kyi grub mtha' la mkhas pa zhig yin par snang bas/ 'grel pa der gsung rab spyi'i brda chad dang / mu stegs kyi grub mtha'i rnam gzhag bkod 'dug ste/ kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam gzhag 'di zhes bstan pa mi 'dug go /slob dpon de yang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs 'khrungs man chad du byon pa zhig yin par zad de/ 'khor lo sngon du ci rigs par/ /zhes pa'i don/ kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi sngon du srung 'khor sgom pa la bshad cing / de yang khro bo rnams zhal gsum phyag drug par byed pa sogs ye shes zhabs lugs dang mthun par byas so/ /yang slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa'i mu tig phreng ba zhes pa yod la/ gzhan yang slob dpon de nyid kyis/ gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog dang / dgra nag gi 'grel pa dang / ma hā ma ya'i 'grel pa dang / yo ga thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa bla med du bkral pa dang / ji bzhin bsnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'grel pa rnams su tshig rigs mthun par/ theg pa chen po 'di la ni rnam par rig pa sems tsam du blta bar bya ste/ de yang mdo sde sa bcu pa las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes pa'i mdo drangs nas lta ba sems tsam du bkral lo/ /slob dpon 'di'i lugs kyis/ theg chen gyi mdo sde mtha' dag sems tsam gyi lta ba ston par 'chad cing / klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa yang de nyid yin par bzhed do/

/'o na bden grub bkag pa ji ltar yin snyam na/ de ni mtshan nyid gsum gyi nang nas kun brtags bden grub bkag pa yin gyis/ gzhan dbang dang yongs grub bden pa bkag pa min no/ /de'i lugs kyi bskyed rim ni/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi chings kyis bcings pa'i rnal 'byor ye shes zhabs lugs dang mthun par ston pas ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i rjes 'brangs yin zhing / bskyed rim de yang sbyang gzhi sbyong ba la shin tu zab pa yin no/ /des na pha rgyud kyi skabs su ye shes zhabs lugs kyi gsang 'dus kyi sgrub thabs ni/ pha rgyud pa gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing / ma rgyud du shānti pa'i lugs de ma rgyud gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin no/ /yang nag po dam tshig rdo rjes byas pa'i dka' 'grel rin chen sbyor phreng zhes pa yod de/ de ni lta ba sems tsam du mi ston kyang / rnam gzhag spyi shānti pa'i rjes 'brangs so/ /yang slob dpon nag po pas byas pa'i dka' 'grel dran pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba yod de/ slob dpon de nyid rten rab tu byung ba dang / rnal 'byor pa gang gi tshul du bzhugs mi gsal yang / bde mchog pa'i nag po pa dang / birwa pa'i dngos slob nag po pa dang / dge slong nag po pa zhes pa yod de/ de rnams gang yang ma yin no/ /yang slob dpon bha wa bha dras mdzad pa'i 'grel pa rnam par bshad pa zhes pa yod de/ yang slob dpon ḍaṃ ka da shas byas pa'i 'grel pa yod la/ 'di nyid la sngar 'gyur du rdo rje gsum gyi kha sbyor rin po che'i phreng ba glang dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur pa/ paṇḍi ta kā ya ta na sgres pos mdzad zer ba 'byung / de la brten nas bstan 'gyur bsdus mkhan dbus pa blo gsal dang / rgyang ro byang 'bum gnyis kyis/ sambu ṭi'i 'grel bar byas te/ de'i bstan 'gyur du bsdus pa yod kyang / phyi 'gyur la bla chen 'phags pa'i slob ma paṇḍi ta bi ma la shrī dang /

gshong blo brtan gyis bsgyur pa/ kyai rdo rje'i 'grel bshad kha sbyor dri ma med pa zhes bya ba/ paṇḍi ta ḍi ka shas mdzad pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ba de nyid don la gnas pa yin no/ /saṃ ṭi'i 'grel par byas pa ni kha sbyor zhes pa'i ming la 'khrul pa yin gyi/ 'di ni rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa slob dpon bha wa bha dras byas pa de nyid kyi 'grel bshad yin no/ /rtsa rgyud kyi tshig ma lus pa la 'grel pa yod pa ni 'di tsam mo/ /yang slob dpon ka me dhe nus byas pa'i dka' 'grel rdo rje'i tshig lta bu zhes pa yod do/ /yang kha che paṇa chen dang dpyal chos bzang gnyis kyis gser sdings kyi gtsug lag khang du 'gyur byas pa'i/ nā ro 'grel chen du grags pa yod cing / dpyal los byas pa'i de nyid kyi dka' 'grel/ sa bcad/ rdzogs rim sgrom lde zhes pa rnams yod do/ /bu ston gyi chos 'byung che chung gsum dang / yo ga'i chos 'byung rnams su 'grel pa de nyid dang / dus 'khor gyi dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa gnyis/ grub chen nā ro ta pas mdzad par byas so/ /de bzhin du jo nang pa rnams kyi lugs la'ang nā ro ta pas byas pa yin te/ brtsams pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ grub chen nā ro ta pa'i sku tshe'i stod la rgyud sde gang 'chad thams cad rang stong gi lta ba ston par bshad cing / de nyid bod kyi dge bshes mang pos bod yul du dar bar byas la/ phyis rting sku tshe'i smad la dus 'khor 'phags yul du 'gyur bas/ de nyid gzhan stong gi lta ba ston par 'dug pas/ sngar gyi rang stong gi lta ba ma dag pa sun dbyung ba'i phyir du/ brtag gnyis kyang gzhan stong gi lta ba ston par bkral ba'i 'grel pa 'di spyan la 'jag ma'i ka ba btsugs nas brtsams zhes zer ba yang rigs pa ma yin te/ de nyid kyi mjug tu/ kha che'i yul du skyes pa yi/ /dge slong snyan grags bzang pos sbyar/ /zhes bshad cing /

grub chen nā ro pa sku tshe'i smad la rten rnal 'byor pa'i tshul du bzhugs pas so/ /yang 'grel pa de nyid la dpyal lo las rgyus che ba med cing / dpyal los yul lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byung ba'i rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa'i dge slong zhig gis sbyar bar bshad kyi/ nā ro pas sbyar bar ma bshad do/ /des na rgya gar na nā ro dkar nag khra gsum zhes grags pa ltar/ rus nā ro yin pa zhig gis byas pa yin gyi/ grub chen nā ro pas byas pa ma yin te/ yin na kyai rdor dpyal lugs/ rngog lugs 'di dang gsum lugs shin tu mi mthun pa/ gang zag gcig gis byas pas khas len pa skyong dka' mo yong ba 'dra'o/ /grub chen nā ro pas ma byas kyang / paṇḍi ta shes rab can gcig gis byas par gsal zhing / de nyid nas bskyed rim grub chen mtsho skyes kyi lugs dang mthun pa dang / rdzogs rim yan lag drug sgom rnal 'byor pas/ zhes pa la/ so sor bsdud dang bsam gtan dang / /srog rtsol dang ni 'dzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting 'dzin dang / /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces sbyor ba yan lag drug ston par 'bru mnan nas/ dus 'khor dang mthun par 'chad do/ /'grel pa de nyid kyi ming la kyai rdor don bsdus zer la/ de nyid kyi 'grel bshad/ kyai rdor don bsdus kyi 'grel pa zhes pa smad ma tshang ba zhig yod/ bod snga ma 'ga' res 'di bod mar byas pa yod kyang / rgya gar gyi yin gyi/ bod ma min no/ /yang grub chen ḍombhi he ru ka'i gsung bgros rim pa bzhin brgyud pa yi ger bkod pa grub chen mi thub zla bas mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel ku mu ti zhes pa dang 'grel pa bcu gnyis/ yang dharmā kirtis byas pa'i 'grel pa gcig dang / nā ro pa'i gsung gi 'od zer bstan pa nā ro pas mdzad zer ba gnyis las/ dang po ni bod kyis byas par sa skya pa'i bla ma rnams 'chad/ phyi ma ni bod mar bu ston rin po ches mdzad do/

/gnyis pa kha ba can du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul la/ bstan pa snga dar la kri yog sde gsum dang / gsang 'dus dang / bde mchog dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rnams dar gyi/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud sogs ni ma dar ro/ /phyi dar la lo chen rin bzang gis bla ma shākya brtson 'grus kyi gur brtag gnyis dang / slob dpon shānti pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa'i 'gyur byas shing / de nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' dang bshad bka' yang byung ngo / /lo chen gyi thugs dam la kyai rdor gcig byung 'dug pa'ang shānti pa'i de nyid yin par zad do/ /lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad tsam la 'brog mis rgya gar la byon te/ shānti pa la khong pa rang gi lugs kyi kyai rdor gyi chos skor rnams gsan cing mkhas par mdzad nas/ bod du 'byon khar lho phyogs ku ba tshal gyi nags khrod na grub chen rnams dang / paṇḍi ta mang po rnams kyi bzhugs gnas de mjal ba la byon pa na/ der dpa' bo rdo rje dang mjal te/ rgyud gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus shing / de gsum gyi bshad bka' dang / lam 'bras rdo rje'i tshig rkang med pa gcig kyang gsan/ slob dpon de nyid dang lhan cig tu ku mu ti yang bsgyur nas bod du byon te/ rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka' rnams dar bar byas shing / rje btsun ga ya dha ra dang lo paṇa du byas nas 'gyur yang mdzad do/ /yang 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bla chen 'brog la sgra'i sa ris dang / 'bigs par ta la sogs pa chos kha yar bslabs shing / gsang sngags kyi chos gnang bar zhus pas/ chos 'dod na gser khur shog gsungs pa la/ gser dgos pa mnyam nyid la rgya gar la phyin na dga' dgongs te byon nas/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje la sogs pa bla ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis tsam bsten te/ gtso bor gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor la mkhas par byas shing / khyad par du nag po dam tshig rdo rje la khong rang gi lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i chos skor rnams gsan nas bod du byon nas/

de'i dbang dang bshad bka' sogs dar bar mdzad cing / 'grel pa sogs kyi 'gyur yang mdzad do/ /yang 'gos kyis rje btsun ga ya dha ra spyan drangs te rgyud gsum gyi dbang bshad kyi bka' sogs gsan cing / paṇḍi ta de nyid dang lo paṇa du mdzad nas rgyud gsum gyi 'gyur yang mdzad do/ /da lta 'gyur tsam yod do/ /lo tsā ba de nyid kyis slob dpon shānti pa'i 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyang bsgyur to/ /de dang 'dab chags su gyi jo lo tsā ba zla ba'i 'od zer gyis/ rje btsun ga ya dha ra phyug po gzhung gi sbas tshab tu spyan drangs te rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka' gsan cing / rgyud gsum gyi 'gyur tsam yang da lta lus so/ /yang gnyos lo tsā ba yon tan grags kyis rje btsun ga ya dha ra la rgyud gsum gyi bshad bka' ni ma gsan cing / de nyid dang lo paṇa du byas te rgyud gsum bsgyur to/ /khong pa'i rjes 'jug gyi re ba rnams na re/ gnyos los trag shad nag po'i rgyud las gzhan bsgyur ba med ces zer yang / saṃ ṭi dang / gur gnyis kyi 'gyur dngos su gnang zhing / rtsa rgyud la'ang yod tshod du 'dug go /yang mar los bla chen 'brog la sgra'i sa ris dang / 'bigs par ta la sogs pa bslabs shing / sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang / sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa yang gsan to/ /sa lugs kyi dge bshes 'ga' res gsang sngags kyi chos gnang ba med zer yang / bla chen mar pa la brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs de nyid kyi lung yang rngog pa rnams la snang ngo / /yang bla ma mar pas rgya gar du byon te grub chen nā ro ta pa la gur brtag gnyis kyi dbang bka' dang / 'grel pa la ma brten pa'i rgyud rkyang la man ngag gi bshad pa re gsan cing / gur la nā ro pa'i gsung bgros zin bris su btab pa/ gur gyi srog shing zhes pa dang / brtag gnyis la rdog chos rdor gyis mar pa'i gsung bgros zin bris su btab pa rin po che'i rgyan zhes pa'i bshad pa yod do/

/phyis rting rngog zhe sdang rdo rje'i dus su rin po che'i rgyan sgam du btsud nas gzhan gyis mi mthong bar byas shing / chos bshad dus tshig ris blo la bzung ste/ 'di nā ro pa nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdam ngag yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyang blo la zung shig ces bsgos te 'chad kyin yod pa las/ khams pa'i grwa pa gcig gis rin chen rgyan brkus te bros so/ /de nas khong rang gis rin po che'i rgyan 'dra brtsams shing / de'i mgor/ mtsho skyes ming bzang shānti pa la sogs/ /grub thob mkhas su re dang mkhas pas kyang / /'di don phyogs re tsam las ma rtogs pas/ /bla ma'i man ngag rin chen rgyan 'dra 'dis/ /'grel pa skar ma zla 'od nub par byas/ /zhes pa 'byung la/ khong rnams kyi bshad pa la/ mtsho skyes ni grub chen mtsho skyes dang / ming bzang ni rdo rje snying 'grel la byed pa yin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /bshad pa de nyid kyang man ngag thon chen po legs po yod cing / 'on kyang gsung rab mtha' dag la ma sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis tshig sbyor 'o le ba tsam dang / dbang gsum pa'i dus su/ byang sems yum gyi mkhar lhung ba las dbang gi ye shes skye ba yin zhing / de nyid kyang don gyi ye shes yin no/ /zhes zer ba la sogs pa'i grub mtha' rtsing mo 'ga' re snang ngo / /de'i rjes su 'jug pa/ rngog thogs med grags kyi bshad pa dang / gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po'i ṭikka la sogs pa du ma yod do/ /mes ston chen pos/ 'khon dge chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ des rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la gnang ste/ mar pa'i bka' chen bzhi dang / dkyil 'khor bdun kar gyi dbang bka' byung yang da lta chad nas med do/ /yang ram sdings ma bas byas pa'i brtag gnyis kyi ṭikka kyai rdor ram lugs zhes pa yod la/ de'ang rngog pa'i rjes 'jug go /ram sdings ma ba sangs rgyas 'byung gnas rdo rje na re/ kye rdo rje'i bshad pa la mun pa mgo bstum gyi bshad pa/

'o ma la chu bsres pa'i bshad pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i bshad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'khon sa skya pa yab sras kyi lugs de yin la / gnyis pa ni 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi lugs te/ res khong nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs de byed pa bzhin/ res mtsho skyes kyi lugs byed pa bzhin byed do/ /gsum pa ni mar pa lugs kyi bshad pa 'di nyid yin te/ tshe gcig lus 'di'i steng du phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i gdam ngag de ston pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ro/ /yang snar thang pa gtum ston blo gros grags kyis byas pa'i ṭikka yod de/ de'ang rngog lugs kyi rjes 'brang yin no/ /de thams cad kyi tshig ris kyang gong gi de bris bshus byas pa tsam dang / dbang gsum pa'i skabs kyi grub mtha' rtsing po de yang thams cad la 'dra bar yod do/ /yang ru mtshams pa skyo ston akṣo bhya badzra gyis byas pa'i ṭikka yod de/ de yang rngog pa'i rjes 'jug yin zhing / khong gsung rab spyi la sbyangs pa yang che zhing / shes rab che bas/ gong gi rnams las tshig sbyor yang bde zhing / rang bzo yang cung mang la/ dag ldan la dgag pa yang 'ga' re byas snang ngo / /yang kyai rdor dpyal lugs zhes pa byung ste/ de yang sman lung gi dpyal se 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan la/ sras dpyal se bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes pa byung la/ khong rnying ma ba yin pas zur du rnying ma slob pa la phyin dus/ gos dmar gyon te se phung gcig gi rtsar bsdad pas zur pa grwa pa mang ba'i stobs kyis/ se rtsa'i mi gos dmar ba de zhes dpyal se rtsa dmar ru bar grags so/ /rnying ma lob pa dang yab can du log byon pas/ yab phyis gsang sngags gsar 'gyur la mos te/ rā los 'gos spyan drangs te gsang 'dus kyi rgyud zhus gsar nyan du btang / khong pas phyag rten la rta bzang po sga dang bcas pa khur te/ 'gos kyi sku mdun du phyin te/

bdag kyang rgyud kyi chos thun nyan gyis chos rar tshud pa zhig dgos zhus pas/ khyod kyi rta byas rung dud 'gro yin/ sga yin zer nas shing la dngul gyi khrab khrob mang po brgyab pa de 'dra la nga'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud zab mo 'chad pa mi yong gsungs nas/ rta la lcags brgyab nas bros song ngo / /de nas khong pas yab can du byon nas sngar gyi rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ yab na re/ 'o khyod gsang ba 'dus pa'am de dang las 'brel med pa'i rtags yin/ da nga'i lag tu he badzra'i glegs bam chung chung zhig byung / de'i nang na nged rang gi yang dag dang lha grangs mthun pa'i lha dgu ma gcig la/ 'khor gyi lha mo yang mtshan mthun pa ke gcig re dang / baitta li sogs pas bskor ba gcig 'dus pas 'di chos bzang po gcig yin par 'dug gi ngas chas bskur/ khyod rang lho bal du rgyugs la 'di slob la shog gsungs nas btang ngo / /de nas dpyal se bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bal por byon te/ pham thing pa sku mched gnyis kyi/ gcen 'jigs med grags pa la grub chen nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i kyai rdo rje'i dbang bka' dang / rtsa rgyud la man ngag gi bshad pa yam me ba/ nā ro pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi yin zer ba gcig gsan/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta gcig dang lhan cig tu slob dpon bha wa bha dra'i 'grel pa la 'gyur yang mdzad/ de nas bod du byon te/ kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ gtor chog sbyin sreg sogs phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i gzhung / las dang po pa'i bya ba'i rim pa zhes pa mdzad byang med pa gcig bsgyur cing / de'i steng nas 'chad nyan yang mang du mdzad do/ /brtag gnyis la'ang 'chad nyan mang po dang / brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u bzhi pa yan chad la ṭikka yang mdzad cing / khong gi grwa pa gcig gis de'i 'phro mthud pa yang 'dug go /la stod lho'i grangs so dga' ldan pa tshul khrims bzang por khong pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i ṭikka gcig yod do/

/gnyis pa de rnams kyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i lugs ngos bzung ba ni/ grub chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa'i lugs ni 'chad byed kyi man ngag de rnams kyi nang nas ches khyad par du 'phags pa yin la/ de la yang grub chen birwa pa nas grub chen ḍombhi ba la brgyud pa'i bshad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gdams ngag 'grel pa lugs su grags pa dang / nag po pa nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gtso bor gyur pa'i bshad pa man ngag lugs su grags pa'i brgyud pa gnyis kyi bcud rje btsun 'brog mi la babs pa/ de'i dngos slob pu hrang pa gsal ba'i snying po ni yum la 'khrungs ma thag nas/ dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum gyi gzhung rnams thugs la yod cing spyod 'jug dang / bslab btus la klog brdar byas pa tsam gyis thugs su chud cing / rje btsun 'brog mi la rgyud gsum tshar mang po gsan/ rgyud gsum gyi gzhung la mchan yang btab ste bla ma la gzigs phul bas/ legs kyis gsungs nas gtod du ma 'dod/ yang skabs shig tu gzhung rnams la mchan dang / dka' sa 'ga' zhig tu zin bris dum pa byas pas bsub gsungs nas subs dgos pa byung / yang 'di 'dra'i bshad pa bzang po chad na mi yong ba 'dug snyam du dgongs nas dka' sa tsho la zin bris btab ste phying khug tu sbas nas phyis rting brtag gnyis la tshig 'grel mang nyung de'i phyed dang gnyis tsam byung pa dang / rgyud gsum char la mchan btab bo/ /yang mkhan chen dge chu ba dgra lha 'bar gyis rgyud gsum gyi mchan sna yang bsrings shing / brtag gnyis la tshig 'grel nang du thum pa'i ṭikka byas/ yang rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos rgyud gsum gyi mchan sna yang bsrings shing / brtag gnyis la dka' 'grel/ sa bcad/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa rnams mdzad la/ slob dpon rin po ches dka' 'grel de nyid nang du thum pa'i rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer dang / rje btsun rin po ches rnam bshad de nyid nang du thim pa'i rnam bshad dag ldan mdzad/

sku mched gnyis kyis kyang rgyud gsum la bla ma gong ma'i mchan sna bsrings pa'i mchan yang mdzad do/ /bar der rje btsun yab sras gsum po gang rung la dngos su thug pa'i brtag gnyis kyi ṭikka byed mkhan drug tsam byung ste bzang po snang ngo / /yang gnyan phul byung pas mdzad pa'i ṭikka yang yod do/ /rje btsun rin po che'i dngos slob dkar shākya grags kyis brtag gnyis la dag ldan gyi tshig ris nyung du btang zhing / 'pho ba'i thad du rtsa'i mngon rtogs gnyis drangs shing / gong 'og thams cad du rgya pho ba lung pa'i gsang 'dus gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi lung mang po drangs pa'i ṭikka dang / rgyud sde spyi rnam/ rgyud kyi mtshan don/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag mngon rtogs ljon shing dang thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsres pa'i spyi don blo gros 'od zer zhes pa mdzad do/ /rje btsun rin po ches rgyud gsum la 'chad nyan mang po mdzad/ grwa pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung kyang / sras kyi thu bo chos rje sa paṇa yin la chos rjes bdag med stod 'grel dang / chos rje pa'i dngos slob chos rje nyid dang lhan cig tu paṇḍi ta dha na shī la dang / paṇḍi ta la su ga ta gnyis la sgra dang / 'bigs par ta dang / snyan ngag dang / ming gi mngon brjod la sogs pa'i tha snyad kyi gtsug lag rnams gsan cing / tshad ma sde bdun dang / rgyud gsum la mkhas pa bla ma khang 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyis chos rje pa'i gsung bgros yin zer ba'i/ dag ldan dang / ljon shing phyogs gcig tu bsres pa'i ṭikka byas so/ /bsre lugs la bla ma gong ma'i lugs dang / bla chen 'phags pa'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po la le'u'i 'grel pa/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag le'u'i don dngos dang gsum du byas pa'i bshad thabs kyi man ngag la/ brjod bya/ rjod byed/ mngon par rtogs pa gang dang 'brel/ bshad pa'i rgyud gang gis gsal bar byed/ lus rnam gzhag gang gi yan lag rgyas bshad yin/

zhes pa'am/ brtag pa dang po'i gong du kha skong zhes pa lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa gang dang 'brel zhes pa'i skabs su ljon shing bsre'o/ /gnyis pa la/ le'u'i 'grel dang / 'brel pa can gyi le'u'i don gnyis su byas pa'i phyi ma la sngar bzhin byas nas/ mngon par rtogs pa gang dang 'brel pa'i thad du bsre'o/ /bla ma khong gi de ni bla ma gong ma'i bsre lugs de yin no/ /yang chos rje pa'i dngos slob/ lo sum cu so lnga'i bar du chos rje pa'i nye gnas byas shing / rgyud gsum mang du nyan pa shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis/ chos rje pa'i gsung bgros yi ger btab pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud gang gis gsal bar byed ces pa'i thad du/ saṃṭi dang gur gnyis kyi tshig ris drangs pa/ rgyud gsum gcig car du bshad pa'i man ngag mu tig lung gi phreng ba zhes pa po ti gcig tsam la/ khong gi gcung po shar pa rdo rje 'od zer gyis zhu dag byas pa yod do/ /chos rje pas rgyud gsum la 'chad nyan yun ring du mdzad cing / grwa pa yang zhang mdo sde dpal/ zhang rgyal ba dpal/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seṅge la sogs pa mkhas pa mang po yod kyang / sras kyi thu bo bla chen 'phags pa yin la/ bla chen gyis khong rang gi dbon po dharmā pha la rakṣa ta'i don du mngon rtogs ljon shing chung ngu / dag ldan chung ba dang / rgyud sde spyi rnam/ mtshan don/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag rgyud kyi mngon rtogs rnams la shog bu kha gras re tsam byas pa mdzad/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab la gnod kyi dogs nas de rnams la mdzad byang ma btab kyang / me mched pa bzhin du shin tu dar bar gyur te/ de la ljon shing chung ngu ni mngon rtogs ljon shing gi don ci hril bsdus nas bder btang pa la/ go rim ni rgyud kyi bzhugs lugs dang bstun nas/ dang por 'bras bu'i rgyud/ de nas lam thabs rgyud/ de nas rgyu rgyud bstan to/ /dag chung ni/ mgor gleng gzhi la gzhi bshad dang /

le'u rnams la bla ma ga ya dha ra'i shin tu thugs rtsis che zer ba'i le'u'i 'grel dang / mchan gyis ma 'thum pa'i dka' sa 'ga' re 'ga' re la 'bru snon dum pa yod pa gcig mdzad do/ /gzhan yang rgyud kyi mchan gnyis dang / sa bcad dang bcas pa mdzad do/ /bla chen gyis kyang rgyud gsum la 'chad nyan yun ring du mdzad cing / grwa pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / dngos slob ṭikka byed mkhan yang bde ba can pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ gung pa blo gros seṅge / gsal la ba dbang phyug grags/ gsal la ba gzhon nu 'bum/ shar pa ye shes grags/ lo spe ba rdor bsod/ brag ri pa mkhan po rdo rje tshul khrims/ dpa' dpung pa shākya dpal/ rung 'bur ba byang chub dpal/ mngon dga' ba kun dga' dbang phyug dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ shang bsreg shing pa rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dre rkang / tshad ma sde bdun dang rgyud gsum la mkhas pa zhig yin zhing / khong gi ṭikka shang bsreg shing du dar ro/ /gsal la ba dbang phyug grags kyi ṭikka ni/ gsal la dang / don mo ri dang / mang mkhar mu khu lung rnams su dar bar byas so/ /lo spe ba rdor bsod kyi ṭikka ni bla brang shar dang / zur khang rnams su dar ro/ /yang bla chen gyi dngos slob chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de'i slob ma la ru ba/ de'i slob ma spang khang pa grags pa dpal bzang gis byas pa'i ṭikka ni byang ngam ring du dar ro/ /byang ngam ring ni/ dang por brtag gnyis/ de nas dus 'khor/ de nas rnam 'grel gyi grwa sar song ngo / /brag ram pa mkhan po rdor tshul gyi slob ma tsam pa dkon mchog bzang pos byas pa'i ṭikka ni mnga' ris su dar ro/ /mdor na ṭikka thams cad kyang che chung gnyis su nges la/ che ba ni dag ldan dang / ljon shing gnyis bsres pa la gzhung gi 'bru bsnan ma tshang ba rnams gsung bgros dang mchan gyis kha bskangs ba ci rigs pa yod do/ /chung pa ni/ dag chung / ljon chung / rgyud sde spyi rnam chung pa sogs yig cha cha chung pa de rnams bsres pa dang /

gsung bgros dang mchan gyis kha bskangs pa ci rigs pa yod do/ /gsal la ba dbang phyug grags/ dpa' lung ba shākya dpal/ rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dre rkang gi ṭikka ni/ dag ldan dang / ljon shing bsres pa la gsung bgros bsnan pa de yin no/ /yang rin po che gzungs kyi dpal/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje theg chen pa rnams kyis byas pa'i ṭikka ni/ chung ba'i tshangs de yin no/ /yang nyi tshe lung pa chos kyi seṅge / gung pa skyo ston dri med/ yag grub pa ma lo/ cog ro ston gzhon/ gnyan tshul khrims rgyal po rnams kyis byas pa'i zin bris re yod la/ gnyan gyi zin bris de ni/ bla chen la chos rje sa paṇa gyis gsungs pa'i gsung bgros btab pa yin pas khyad par du 'phags so/ /bla chen la bshad pa mang du thob pa yod kyang / yongs su rdzogs pa dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal yin la/ de bla chen gyi dbon po'i slob dpon yin zhing / dbus kyi dga' ldan du rgyud gsum gyi 'chad nyan la bskos/ hor rgyal pos rgyud 'dzin lnga brgya tsam la chas rgyun du bsgrengs pa yang byung ngo / /bkra shis dpal gyi dngos slob na bza' pa la/ chos rje bla mas/ rgyud gsum la bshad bkar 'gro ba tsam/ dka' sa tsho la bshad pa dum tsam dang / gzhan rnams la lung tsam gsan/ yang dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal gyi slob ma dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ de'i slob ma slob dpon grub rgyal/ de la chos rje bla ma dam pa/ yang bla chen gyi dngos slob bla ma 'phags pa rgyal mtshan/ de'i dngos slob bo dong sgro mon can pa rin chen dpal bzang / de la bla ma dam pas zhus so/ /chos rje bla mas brtag gnyis la dag ldan ljon shing che chung gnyis/ gzhan yang sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde bzhi char gyi brda chad thams cad tshang ba'i ṭikka chen po gcig dang / de las bsdus pa'i ṭika chung gcig dang gnyis mdzad/ mdzad lugs kyi don spyi ni che ba legs/ de'i dngos slob la gnas drug pa blo gros mtshungs med/

bo ston 'jigs med grags pa/ rtag pa chos mgon/ ya 'brog kha ba lung pa zhang ston bsod nams grags kyi ṭikka yod la gnas drug pa ni byams chos dang / dus 'khor la mkhas shing / ṭikka de ni bla ma dam pa'i de la 'phri bsnan byas pa yin zhing / der dag ldan la dgag pa byas pa yang yod do/ /bu ston gyi ṭikka che chung gsum las che ba ni chos rje bla ma'i de gzhir bzhag la/ tshig bgros bder btang pa tsam yin no/ /bar pa ni de'i steng nas spyi don rnams 'phri ba'o/ /chung ba ni bla chen 'phags pa'i mchan gnyis dang / sa bcad bsdoms pa yin no/ /de rnams ni nyug rgyal khang dang / sa skya'i sgog ra rnams su dar ro/ /yang tsha rags pa rgyal po dpal gyi ṭikka che ba lung gi phreng ba/ chung ba gzhung don gsal ba gnyis so/ /che ba ni chos rje bla ma'i ṭikka che ba dang don spyi 'dra'o/ /tsha rags pa ni chos rje bla ma la chos 'brel yod tsam yin la/ slob gnyer byas sa gtso bor sro lung pa kun smon dang / grub chen na bza' pa sku mched bcu gcig gi che shos chos rje bsod nams dpal la bshad pa dang / chung ba na bza' pa la man ngag gsan/ yang bro lung pa'i dngos slob g.yag sde ze dmar ba sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang / sre'u chung pa lce blo ldan seṅge dang / rngog pa saṅge sgra rnams kyi'ang slob ma yin no/ /yang bla ma dam pa'i dngos slob zad pa blo gsal gyi ṭikka yang yod do/ /de thams cad kyi brten sa gtso bo dka' 'grel ku mu ta nyid yin no/ /de rnams kyi nang nas kyang rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab gzhir bzhag nas gtan la dbab par bya ba yin no/ /de yang gong ma'i lugs kyi rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag mtshan don/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag rgyud kyi mngon rtogs te tshul bzhi sngon du song nas rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa yin pas/ de'ang rgyud sde so so'i rnam par gzhag pa dang / rgyud sde so so'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs dang /

gang bshad par bya ba'i rgyud sde ngos gzung ba la/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag gam/ ngos zin pa'i rgyud kyi mtshan don de ji lta bu zhes dpyod pas/ de'i rjes su rgyud kyi mtshan don/ rgyud thams cad kyi tshig brling zhing gyong bas 'chad byed kyi man ngag dgos la/ khyad par rtsa rgyud 'di lta bu rnams la 'chad byed kyi man ngag med na gtan nas 'chad mi nus pas/ de'i rjes su bshad thabs kyi man ngag 'grel lo/ /'di rnams phyogs gcig tu byas pa'i bstan bcos ni/ rgyud sde spyi yi rnam gzhag la le'u gcig rgyud kyi mtshan don la le'u gcig bshad thabs kyi man ngag la le'u gcig byas pa la rgyud sde spyi yi rnam gzhag ces ming du btags pa/ rje btsun bsod nams rtsi mos mdzad pa yod do/ /rgyud kyi mngon rtogs ni/ spyir kyai rdo rjer bde mchog lta bu'i sgrub thabs kyi bskyed rim nyi tshe ba tsam la mngon rtogs zhes btags pa yod mod kyis/ 'dir ni gdul bya gang gi lam nyams su len tshul gyi go rim la/ mngon rtogs zhes bzhag pa yin te/ de'i tshul yang dang po kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ de nas lam thabs rgyud/ de nas grub pa 'bras bu'i rgyud ston pa ste rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs ljon shing ngo / /'di dag kyang slob dpon ghar pa ri pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rgyud la 'jug pa las/ don spyi 'di ltar du bshad pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung bgros las rim pa bzhin du byung ba yi ger bkod pa yin no/ /thog mar rgyud sde spyi yi rnam par bzhag pa la/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i sde snod la theg pa che chung gnyis/ theg chen la phar phyin pa dang / rdo rje theg pa gnyis/ rdo rje theg pa la phar phyin theg pa las rdo rje theg pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul/ khyad par 'phags pa'i rgyud sde'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhan du rtogs la/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen la phar phyin theg pa dang /

rdo rje theg pa gnyis su grangs nges te/ de nyid nyams su len mkhan gyi gang zag de la 'dod yon lnga'i 'ching ba spong bar sla zhing spong nus la/ 'dod yon lnga'i 'ching ba spong dka' zhing / spong mi nus pa gnyis su nges pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang sam ṭi'i rgyud phyi ma las/ theg pa dang chen po 'di gnyis ni/ theg pa chen po ste byang chub sems dpa'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o/ /de bas na theg pa chen po rnam pa bdun du sbyor ba'i phyir ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde dag tu grub bo/ /de'i phyir ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i theg pa chen po ni/ skye ba 'dir sangs rgyas la sogs pa rab tu sgrub par byed pa'i phyir/ de'i yon tan dam par gyur pa stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa ste/ zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du spyod bsdus sgron me las kyang / dman pa la mos pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ chags bral gyi kun tu spyod pa bstan to/ /rgya che ba la mos pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa bstan to/ /zab pa la mos pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ 'dod chags kyi kun tu spyod pa bstan to/ /zhes gsungs/ slob dpon shānti pa'i 'grel par yang / dman pa la mos pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi theg pa bstan to/ /rgya che ba la mos pa rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa bstan to/ /zab pa la mos pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ rdo rje theg pa bstan to/ /zhes bshad do/ /gong gi chen po rnam pa bdun du sbyor ba'i phyir zhes pa ni/ theg pa de dag chen po rnam pa bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas theg pa chen por 'jog la/ chen po bdun ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin bsgrub pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang /

/yang dag bsgrub pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las/ gsang sngags khyad par du 'phags tshul ni/ 'o na saṃ ṭi'i lung der yang / phar phyin las sngags khyad par du 'phags par bshad na/ khyad chos gang gi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin zhe na/ slob dpon ṭi pi ta ka ma las/ tshul gsum sgron mar/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /khyad chos bzhis khyad du 'phags so/ /don gcig pa ni/ rtogs bya'i lta ba spros bral stong pa nyid yin par don gcig sbyin sogs phar phyin drug gi spyod pa nyams su len par don gcig 'thob bya'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas gcig la dmigs par don gcig go /de lta na'ang stong pa nyid de rtogs pa'i thabs la ma rmongs pas khyad par du 'phags te/ phar phyin theg par ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid de rtogs pa la gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis stong pa nyid du dpyad nas/ de'i steng du rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa las gzhan pa'i rtogs byed kyi thabs med la/ 'dir de khas len pa'i steng du ye shes phab dus kyi stong pa dang / dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi myong ba la sogs pa stong pa nyid de myur du rtogs pa'i thabs mang po yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ye shes phab pa'i tshe/ sems nyid bde ba chen po'i rnam par skyes te/ des stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs par byed pa yin la/ yo ga'i gzhung 'ga' zhig tu/ ye shes mchog babs pa na sa dang po'i ye shes dngos su skye bar bshad do/ /rgyud sde bzhi la mchog dman gyi rim pas/ bla med kyi ye shes 'bebs lugs ltar gzhan gsum la med kyang /

rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la yang ye shes 'bebs lugs re yod do/ /thabs mang ba ni/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis ka bsgrub pa la thabs mang bas so/ /mchog bsgrub pa'i thabs mang ste/ rnal 'byor chen por 'bras bu sku gnyis sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang / yo ga man chad la gzugs sku sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor dang / chos sku sgrub par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gnyis yod pas so/ /mtshan bcas ni/ yo gar bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa/ de la ye shes pa gzhug pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs pa dang / spyod rgyud du bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed/ mdun du sangs rgyas spyan drangs pa la sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa'i sgo nas dngos grub len pa dang / bya rgyud du mdun du sangs rgyas spyan drangs pa la sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa'i sgo nas dngos grub len par bshad cing / phar phyin theg par de lta bu ma bshad pas so/ /thun mong bsgrub pa la yang thabs mang ste/ phar phyin theg par longs spyod chen po 'dod na'ang / 'dir sbyin pa btang nas phyi ma de'i 'bras bu longs spyod la sgug pa dang / tshe 'dir 'dod na so nam la sogs pa 'jig rten pa rnams dang thun mong du gyur pa las thabs gzhan med cing / sngags pas ni/ lha mo nor rgyun ma dang / 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin lta bu zla ba gsum la sogs par bsgrubs pas longs spyod dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dang / shes rab chen po 'dod na'ang phar phyin theg par gsung rab la thos pa chen po byas nas/ shes rab cher gtong ba las gzhan med cing / sngags pas ni/ de'i steng du rje btsun 'jam dbyangs lta bu zla ba drug la sogs pa bsgrubs pas shes rab shin tu chen por 'gyur ba yod do/ /dka' ba med pa la/ rin po che pas/ phar phyin theg par bskal pa mang por mgo dang rkang lag la sogs pa sbyin par gtong dgos pas dka' thub dang dka' spyad dang bcas pa yin la/

rdo rje theg par ni 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod cing lam sgrub par byed pas dka' ba med pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed pa la/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam ni dka' ba dang bcas/ dka' thub dang bcas/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam ni/ dka' spyad dang dka' thub med ces pa ste/ phar phyin theg par zhi gnas sgom pa las byung ba'i shin sbyangs pa'i bde ba dang / bsam gtan sgom pa las byung ba'i bde ba yod mod/ de ni 'di yang zhi gnas sgom pa yod par khas len la/ de'i steng du rgyud sde bzhi'i lam sgom tsam nyid nas 'dod chags rigs bzhi'i bde ba 'dren nus pa yin no/ /dbang po rno bas khyad par du 'phags pa ni don du gnyer bya sangs rgyas gcig nyid las med pa la/ de nyid sngags pas tshe gcig la 'thob la/ phar phyin theg pa nas bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa 'thob pa'i phyir/ dper na lha sa'i jo bo dang / sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs lta bu mjal ba la zhag gcig gis sleb pa'i mi dang / lo dang zla ba la sogs pa'i sleb pas mi gnyis dbang po rno rtul yod pa bzhin no/ /lung 'di ni slob dpon kṛ mi ta ka ma las rang dgar brtsams pa'i tshig ma yin gyi/ rgyud kyi lung tshig drangs nas/ de nyid rtsa bar byas te/ khyad chos bzhi po de ston pa la 'grel pa shlauka bzhi tsam/ de nyid rtsa bar byas te rang 'grel kha gras bcu tsam yod pa gcig brtsams pa yin te/ dper na/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud du/ rnam snang gi byang chub kyi sems/ phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /zhes 'byung ba la/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis de rtsa bar byas nas byang chub sems 'grel brtsams pa bzhin no/ /de'ang tshul gsum sgron mer/ sngags kyi bstan bcos khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa dang / mnga' bdag mai tri ba'i de kho na nyid bcu par sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/

/zhes 'byung ngo / /rgyud gang gi lung yin snyam na/ rje 'gos kyi gsang 'dus kyi stong thun du/ siddhi ka ra'i rgyud las/ zhes pa dang / gnyan phul byung ba'i bde mchog gi ṭikka dang / rig pa mchog gi rgyud rgyas pa las/ zhes drangs/ dang po legs grub ste gnyis ka'ang bya ba'i rgyud do/ /tshul gsum sgron me'i 'bru snon ltar na bla med du 'dug go /'o na legs grub kyi lung yin na rig pa mchog gi lung yin pa sogs 'gal lo snyam na/ lung tshig gcig nyid mang por 'byung ba mi 'gal te/ 'di la gsal bya ci yang med/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad shlauka gcig pu 'di rgyud bla ma'i rtsa tshig mngon rtogs rgyan gyi rtsa tshig de bzhin du mdo sde mang por yang 'byung zhing / bla med gshed mar le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa dang / mi g.yo ba bla med kyi rgyud du'ang 'byung ba bzhin no/ /'di la sṛ pi ta ka ma la'i/ tshul gsum sgron me'i 'chad tshul dang / slob dpon ye shes grags pa dang / rgyal ba mnga' bdag me tri ba/ rgya gar phyag na dang bcas pa dpon slob kyis bkral pa'i lugs las/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyis bshad pa ni phyi ma'o/ /'di la kha cig na re/ sngags kyi gdul bya chags can dang / phar phyin gyi gdul bya chags bral 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pas/ 'dod yon la chags pa mi spong bar lam sgom pa dang / chags pa de spong ba'i lam sgom pa ni theg pa gnyis su 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /zhes zer ro/ /'di la bshad par bya ste/ theg pa de gnyis kyi gdul bya la 'dod yon la chags pa ma spangs par lam sgom pa dang / spong ba'i lam sgom pa yod pas 'byed na ni gnyis ka la gnyis ka yod pas khyad par des theg pa so so bar 'byed mi nus te/ 'di ltar phar phyin theg pa'i lam du zhugs pa'i khyim pa'i byang sems mi tshangs spyod ma spangs pa du ma yod cing / bram ze'i khye'u skar ma lta bu'i thabs la mkhas pa la/

gzhan don chen po dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ mi tshangs spyod gnang ba yang du ma yod pa'i phyir dang / sngags kyi theg pa'i gdul bya la'ang 'dod yon la sred pa spangs pa du ma yod pa'i phyir te/ gzhan du na sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du 'dod pa'i 'dod chags las grol ba mi srid pa'am/ sangs rgyas nas kyang de ma spangs pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /gal te de gnyis kyi gdul bya gang yin la mi byed kyis/ /rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'am/ gtso bo'i gdul bya thog mar lam de la 'jug pa'i dbang du byed la/ de yang 'dod yon la chags pa ched du mi spong bar theg pa de'i lam sgom du rung ba tsam ma yin gyis/ chags pa de lam gyi grogs su byed nus pas grol ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i skal ba can yin min gyi dbang du byed do snyam na/ de 'dra ba theg pa de nyid la thog mar 'jug pa'i gang zag gi khyad par du sbyar na rung gis/ theg pa'i 'byed byed min no/ /de bzhin du lam bde bas brgyan ma brgyan dang / lus dang sems la gnad du bsnun pa'i khyad par gyis kyang / theg pa gnyis su dbye bar mi nus te/ zhi gnas bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shin sbyang gi bde ba la byed na/ de ni phar phyin theg pa la yang yod la/ khams dkar dmar gyi 'phro 'du las byung ba'i bde chen la byed na/ rnal 'byor bla med ma yin pa gzhan la med pa'i phyir ro/ /lta ba'i sgo nas kyang mi 'byed de/ spros bral rtogs pa'i lta ba de gnyis ka la yod par 'dra ba'i phyir/ nyams len spyod pa'i sgo nas kyang mi 'byed de/ gnyis kas kyang phar phyin drug gi spyod pa nyams su len dgos par 'dra ba'i phyir/ sems bskyed kyi sgo nas kyang mi 'byed de/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blo bskyed dgos par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na gang gis 'byed snyam na/ theg pa chen po gnyis ka'i yang mngon par 'dod pa'i don gyi gtso bo ni gzhan don yin gyi/

rang gi 'thob bya'i byang chub ma yin la/ gdul bya la dngos su gnang nas de dag gi don bsgrub pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos sku min la/ gzugs sku'i rnam pa nyid yin zhing / de la zab mo rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis chos sku dang / rgya che ba'i thabs kyis gzugs kyi sku sgrub pa gnyis las/ zab mo rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis mi 'byed kyi/ gzugs kyi sku sgrub pa'i thabs la lam gyi lus mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod pas/ theg pa gnyis su mdzad pa yin te/ phar phyin theg pa ba rnams ni chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid spros pa dang bral ba sgom pas/ chos sku'i rnam pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i lam sgom pa yod kyang / gzugs kyi sku mtshan dpes spras pa dang 'dra bar bsgom pa'i lam med la/ sngags la ni yod do/ /de yang phar phyin theg pa la bla ma rnams la skyel ba dang bsu ba la sogs pa byas pas/ 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal gyi rten la mtshan dpe rjes mthun pa thob pa sogs kyis/ mtshan dpe brgyud nas sgrub byed kyi rgyu yod kyang / dngos su sgrub byed kyi rgyu/ rang nyid mtshan dpes spras pa'i lha skur bsgom pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor med la/ sngags la ni de yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yod pa'i sgrub byed ni/ gur las/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byed brgyad cur ldan/ /de phyir thabs des bsgrub bya ste/ /thabs ni ston pa'i gzugs can no/ /zhes dang / thams cad gsang ba las kyang / sangs rgyas nyid kyang mdor bsdus na/ /ting 'dzin ye shes las nges 'byung / /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor ma rtogs par/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor pas mi thob/ /ces pa dang / de nyid 'dus pa'i dum bu dang po las/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yis/ /rang gi rdul ni phra mo rnams/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni skur bsgoms na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/

/zhes pa dang / bya spyod nas gsungs pa'i tshul ni/ rnam snang mngon byang gi bsdus don gyi 'grel pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa las 'di las mtshan ma dang bcas pa/ mtshan ma med pa rnams kyi go rim bzhin du yongs su dag pa dang / yongs su ma dag pa'i sku gnyis kyi bye brag gi sgo nas lha'i sku'i ngo bo nyid rnam pa gnyis su bstan to/ /zhes lung du ma drangs so/ /khong pa'i lugs la bya rgyud la bdag skyed khas len pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de nyid kyis yin no/ /de la spyir/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni/ gdul bya'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa spong ba'i ched du yin pas/ 'dod yon gyi 'ching ba spong ba sla zhing / spong nus pa'i gang zag la phar phyin theg pa bstan na grol ba dang / 'dod yon gyi 'ching ba spong dka' zhing / spong mi nus la bla na med pa'i byang chub snying nas thob 'dod pa'i gang zag de la rdo rje theg pa bstan na grol bar 'gyur ba la dgongs nas de ltar du gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhan du na khyed kyi gnod byed de lta na/ spyod bsdus sgron me las/ dman pa la mos pa rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du chags bral gyi kun tu spyod pa dang / zab pa la mos pa rjes su gzung ba'i phyir 'dod chags kyi kun tu spyod pa gsungs par bshad pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa nyams su len mkhan gyi gang zag de la 'dod yon la chags pa spong nus mi nus gnyis ka yod la/ rdo rje theg pa nyams su len mkhan gyi gang zag de la yang 'dod yon gyi chags pa spong nus pa du ma yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /ces sogs/ gang zag dbang po rno rtul bzhi rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ bya rgyud nyams su len mkhan gyi gang zag de la yang /

dbang bo rnon po du ma yod cing / bla med nyams su len mkhan gyi gang zag de la yang dbang po rtul po du ma yod pa'i phyir ro/ /lung de rnams kyis ni spyir lha'i rnal 'byor bzang po yin zhes pa dang / bskyed rim sgom pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la yang nges pa stong nyid la drangs nas/ stong pa nyid de yang gzugs kyi rnam pa rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha'i skur shar ba gcig dgos so/ /zhes bstan gyis/ rdo rje theg pa phar phyin theg pa las khyad par 'phags pa cung zad kyang ma bstan cing / bya ba'i rgyud la/ bdag nyid mtshan dpes spras pa'i lha'i skur bsgom par ma bshad pas so/ /spyir lha'i rnal 'byor rdo rje theg pa phar phyin theg pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgrub byed kyi zur gcig yin par/ mchog sgrub pa la thabs mang bar bstan pa'i skabs su bshad zin to/ /theg pa de nyid la thog mar 'jug pa'i gang zag gi khyad par du sbyar na rung gi theg pa'i 'byed byed du mi rung zhes pa yang mi 'gal te/ theg pa de nyid la thog mar 'jug pa'i gang zag gi khyad par du rung na theg pa'i 'byed byed du rung dgos pa'i phyir te/ theg pa de nyid kyang nyams su len mkhan gyi gang zag la ltos nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa gcig tu na khyed kyi de rgyud kyi lung bkag par song ste/ lung de la slob dpon kṛ pi ta ka ma la'i 'bru snon de ni rnal 'byor bla med ma gtogs rgyud sde 'og ma la ma khyab pas phyogs gcig par song / sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bshad tshul de ni gtogs rtags su song ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhi spong ba dang gzhi mi spong ba lam du byed pa yang sa skya pa'i rang bzo min te/ slob dpon zhi ba mtshos de kho na nyid grub pa dang / spyod bsdus sgron me dang / slob dpon sman zhabs kyi gsang 'dus kyi 'grel par yang de ltar du bshad pa'i phyir/ 'di la red mda' ba na re/

gzhi bsten pa lam byed dang / lha'i rnal 'byor yod med kyi sgo nas 'jog pa gnyis don gyis gnad gcig tu song ste/ 'dod yon lam du byed pa yang rnal 'byor dang ldan pa kho nas lam du byed pa yin gyis/ mi ldan na lam du byed rgyu mi yong ngo zhes gsungs so/ /'o na rnal 'byor bla med la 'dod yon lam byed yod du chug na'ang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la ji ltar 'thad snyam na/ rnal 'byor rgyud la'ang rnal 'byor bla med ltar gyi 'dod yon bsten pa lam byed med na'ang / kho rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa'i 'dod yon bsten pa lam byed gcig yod la/ de bzhin du spyod rgyud la'ang rnal 'byor rgyud ltar du med na'ang kho rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa gcig yod/ bya rgyud la'ang spyod rgyud ltar med kyang kho rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa gcig yod de/ chos sku'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon lam du byed pa dang / gzugs sku'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon zag med du lam du byed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yul snang thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la longs spyod pa phar phyin theg par yang yod kyang / 'dir 'dod yon la longs spyod pa po bdag nyid dang / spyad bya 'dod yon dang / longs spyod pa'i tshul rnams stong pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas spyod pa dang / sgom pa po'i gang zag dang / stong nyid rtogs tshul la yang khyad par yod do/ /gnyis pa ni bdag nyid sgyu ma tsam du shes pa'i lus kyi gnas rnams su gsang sngags bkod de phyag rgyas gtugs shing / mdun du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la dmigs pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la longs spyod pa'o/ /gsum pa 'dod yon zag med du shes pa'i sgo nas longs spyod pa ni rgyud sde bzhi po thams cad la khyad par med par yod do/ /gsum pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyud sde'i dbye ba la/

bzhir dbye ba/ lngar dbye ba/ drug tu dbye ba/ gsum du dbye ba'i lugs so/ /jo bo'i lam sgron rang 'grel du bdun du dbye ba/ rnying ma ba rnams dgur dbye ba rnams re zhig bzhag dang po ni grub chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i lugs te/ de'ang rtsa rgyud las/ rgod dang blta ba lag bcangs dang / /'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis kyis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /zhes pa dang / de bzhin du sambu ṭi las kyang / rgod dang blta ba dag gis kyang / /'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis kyis/ /srin bu'i tshul gyi rgyud bzhir nges/ /gsungs te/ srin bu'i tshul gyi zhes pa ni/ ljon shing la gnas pa'i srin bus shing zos nas ljon shing zad par byed pa ltar/ rgyud sde bzhis kyang 'dod chags rigs bzhi dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis nyams su blangs pa las/ 'dod chags rigs bzhi po de bde ba chen po'i ye shes su bsgyur ba'i sgo nas zad par byed ces pa'o/ /rdo rje gur las kyang / dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa lngar byed pa ni/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs te/ bya ba'i rgyud/ rtogs pa'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ gnyis ka'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud do/ /dang po ni/ bya rgyud bzhir bzhag pa la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa/ bya rgyud sngags dang sman la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa rtog pa'i rgyud do/ /gnyis ka'i rgyud ni de nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni bde mchog rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ba'i lugs te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/

/zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas slob dpon lwa ba pa la sogs pa rgyud sde drug tu bzhed do/ /de yang / bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med la/ pha'i rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu/ ma'i rgyud he badzra lta bu/ ma'i yang ma'am/ gsang ba'i yang gsang ba rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud do/ /gsum du byed pa ni/ grub chen kun snying gi lugs te/ phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /zhes pa'i don/ phyi ni bya spyod gnyis/ gsang ba ni yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud do/ /slob dpon 'di'i lugs kyis rnal 'byor bla med khas len kyang / yo ga'i khongs su 'dus par bzhed cing / de las zab pa logs na yod par mi bzhed do/ /rnal 'byor bla med du rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /zhes par bshad pas de ltar khas len rgyu yin yang / slob dpon a bhya rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas/ phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /zhes par 'chad do/ /slob dpon des kyang man ngag snye mar/ yo ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsang bar byas te rnal 'byor bla med la yar sbyar ro/ /a bhya rgyud sde gnyis su 'dod pa'i shes byed la/ phreng bar/ phyi nang dbye ba shes pa yis/ /rgyud kyi de nyid shes par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs cho ga ni/ /ston pas rgyud sde gnyis su gsungs/ /zhes gsang sngags la phyi nang gnyis su byas nas/ yo ga man chad phyi dang / rnal 'byor bla med la nang du byas so/ /yang slob dpon shānti pa'i lugs kyi rgyud sde lngar 'dod de/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gsum dang / bla med la pha bla med dang / ma bla na med pa gnyis su 'dod do/ /slob dpon kṛ pi ta ka la las kyang / rgyud sde lngar 'dod de/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bla med la pha bla med dang / ma bla ma med gnyis so/ /slob dpon bha wa bha dra dang / ḍaṃ ka da sha gnyis kyi lugs la'ang rgyud sde lngar 'dod de/

rgod dang blta ba dag gi dang / /sogs dang / dgongs pa'i skad ni ma grags pa/ /zhes pa bzhi po de'i steng du ma'i rgyud bsnan pas lnga'o/ /de thams cad kyang dbye bsdu tsam yin gyis/ rgyud sde bzhir ma 'dus pa med do/ /bzhir dbye ba la/ phyi rol mu stegs byed la nas/ gsum ka chos su smra ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar spyi rnam chen mo bzhin no/ /de la gti mug can tshangs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gti mug kun tu spyod cing / gtsang sbra chos su khas len pa de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du khrus dang gtsang sbra gtso bor ston pa bya ba'i rgyud/ zhe sdang can khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'tshe ba chos su smra ba de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du drag po'i las gtso bor ston pa spyod pa'i rgyud/ 'dod chags can dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'dod chags chos su smra ba de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud gsungs/ rkyen snyoms pa skabs stobs kyi gsum ga chos su smra ba ni/ 'dod chags chos su smra ba'i slob dpon dang 'phrad na 'dod chags kyi spyod pa byed/ de bzhin du zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / mdor na gang yang ma bkag pa'i spyod pa byed la/ de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs te/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu dang por/ 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir lha thams cad chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ dum bu gnyis pa zhe sdang can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir lha thams cad khro bo'i nyams can/ dum bu gsum pa gti mug can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir lha thams cad zhi ba'i nyams can/ dum bu bzhi pa ma nges pa rjes su gzung ba'i phyir lha thams cad kyi sku mdog dang nyams sna tshogs dang ldan par gsungs so/ /de la rin po che pas/ rje btsun rtse mos rgyud sde spyi rnam du/ de ltar na mu stegs byed pa la log pa'i spyod pa bzhi yod pas de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyud sde bzhi yin no/

/zhes de nyid bsdus pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas sngon gyi slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs dang / kun dga' snying po la sogs pa bzhed do zhes grag go /zhes bshad kyang / de dag gi bshad pa ma mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /kha cig na re/ gang zag bzhi po de dag de dang des 'dul srid pa la dgongs nas de ltar du gsungs zhes smra ba ni/ rgyud sde bzhi'i sgo nas 'jug pa rnams kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ngos mi zin te/ de dag re res kyang de bzhi ka'i gang zag 'dul srid pa'i phyir/ rgyud sde de dag gi gdul bya'i gtso bo la de dag dgos par 'dod na/ shin tu mi rigs te/ sngags kyi theg pa'i gdul bya'i gtso bo rnams ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug pa'i gdul bya mchog yin pas de la sngon du lta ba log pa la zhugs pa gcig mi dgos pa'i phyir dang / dang po nas grub mtha' phyin ci log la ma zhugs par yang dag pa'i grub mtha' la zhugs pa rnams rgyud de dag gi gdul bya'i gtso bor mi 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir ro/ /slob dpon kun snying gi bzhed pa yang ma yin te/ des mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus kyi 'grel par/ khyab 'jug la 'dod chags can du byas 'dug gi zhe sdang can khyab 'jug rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ zhes ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ro/ /'o na khyed rang gi lugs kyi mtshan nyid lam rim gyis skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum gyi khrid de/ gang zag gsum po de 'dul srid pa la dgongs nas bstan pa yin nam/ gdul bya'i gtso bo la dgongs/ dang po mi rigs te/ skyes bu chen po'i khrid lta bu gcig gis kyang gang zag gsum ka 'dul srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na skyes bu chung ngu'i khrid kyi gdul bya'i gtso bo gang yin/ mngon mtho tsam don du gnyer ba'i gang zag de'o zhe na/ 'o na jo bo rje la byang chub lam gyi sgron me zhu mkhan gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i lha bla ma byang chub 'od de/

skyes bu chung ngu'i khrid kyi gdul bya'i gtso bo ma yin par 'gyur te/ mngon mtho tsam don du gnyer ba'i gang zag de gdul bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud nas bstan pa'i 'dod chags kyi kun spyod rnams 'dod chags can khyab 'jug 'dul srid pa la dgongs nas de ltar du bstan pa yin nam/ de gdul bya'i gtso bo yin pa la dgongs/ dang po ltar na de yang mi rigs te/ des 'dod chags can dang / zhe sdang can dang / gti mug can gsum ka 'dul srid pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs pa'i gang zag mchog de/ rgyud de'i gdul bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis phyir ro/ /gzhan yang dang po nas grub mtha' phyin ci log la ma zhugs par yang dag pa'i grub mtha' la zhugs pa rnams dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi gdul bya'i gtso bor mi 'gyur ba'i skyon du 'gyur te/ drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi po de dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi gdul bya'i gtso bor mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni nang pa la grub mtha' smra ba bzhi yod pas zhes pa nas/ yang dbu ma pa dag gzung ba med pas der 'dzin med/ /ces gzung ba bden par ma grub na/ de la ltos pa'i 'dzin pa'ang bden par mi 'grub pas/ don dam par gzung 'dzin gnyis ka mi 'dod la/ kun rdzob tu gnyis ka 'dod do/ /de dang mthun par rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i bskyed chog ni/ dang por bdag dam tshig sems dpar bskyed/ de la ye shes pa gzhug pa ste/ kun rdzob tu gzung 'dzin gnyis 'dod pa dang 'dra/ don dam par gnyis ka mi 'dod pa ltar/ ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol ba'ang mi 'dod pas/ ye shes sems dpa' mi gshegs pa'i bskyed chog ces bya'o/ /zhes spyi rnam ltar ro/ /de la rin po che pas/ rje btsun rtse mos de ltar bskyed chog mi 'dra ba bzhis rgyud sde bzhir bzhag pa ni/

ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / slob dpon kun dga' snying po la sogs pa bzhed do zhes gsungs pa yang / de dag gi bshad pa ma mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs/ kha cig na re/ yang bod kyi bla ma dag sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba bzhi dang sgo bstun nas lha'i bskyed chog mi 'dra ba bzhi'i sgo nas rgyud sde bzhi bzhag pa/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'phags pa yab sras dang / ye shes zhabs rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa bzhed par 'chad pa yang / slob dpon de dag gsang ba 'dus pa yin zhing / 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa las/ bya rgyud kyi skabs su rang lhar snyems pa med pa dang / ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba med par bshad pa tsam la dpag par snang bas grub mtha' bzhi dang sgo bstun pa la shes byed ci yang mi snang ngo / /rang sangs rgyas dang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bskyed chog sbyar yang / rang rgyal grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i ya gyal min pa'i phyir dang / bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med pa ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i lung don min pa yang 'chad par 'gyur bas mi 'thad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la slob dpon kun dga' snying pos gtan nas ma bshad zer ba yang dka' ste/ rnam snang sgyu drar/ rnal 'byor gsum du shes byas te/ /byin gyis brlabs dang yongs brtags dang / /gzugs nyid yongs su gyur pa'o/ /rnal 'byor sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ slob dpon kun snying gis rnal 'byor gsum ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor/ phyi don bden par 'dod pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir bka' stsal pa dang / yongs su brtags pa'i rnal 'byor/ sems tsam pa rnams rjes su gzung ba dang / gzugs yongs su gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ dbu ma pa rnams yongs su gzung ba'i phyir du bka' stsal par bshad cing /

rnal 'byor dang po ni bya rgyud kyi nyams len du gsungs so/ /grub mtha' bzhi dang sgo bstun pa la shes byed ci yang mi snang gsungs kyang / phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyud sde bzhi gsungs dgos na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba bzhi rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rgyud sde gsungs pa shin tu yang rigs pa dang / rang rgyal grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i ya gyal ma yin yang / sems tsam gyi grub mtha' khas len mkhan gyi rang rgyal zhig yod na/ de nyid kyi don grub la/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed med par ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i lung don de yin min 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dod lha gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa ni zhes pa nas/ bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs so/ /zhes pa'i bar spyi rnam ltar ro/ /rin po che pas/ grub chen nag po pas gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal bar/ dus ni rnam bzhi'i dbye ba las/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhir 'gyur te/ /zhes gsungs pas dus bzhi la ltos nas rgyud sde bzhir bshad mod/ de ni 'dod chags rigs bzhi la ltos nas bzhir dbye ba las logs su bzhag tu med do/ /rdzogs ldan gyi dus kyi gdul bya rnams la gtso bor bltas pa tsam gyis chags pa'i gdung ba sel nus pa'i chags pa yod pa dang / gsum ldan pa rnams la de'i steng du rgod pa dang / gnyis ldan pa rnams la de'i steng du lag bcangs dang / rtsod dus kyi gdul bya rnams la phan tshun dbang po gnyis sbyar bas 'khrig pa'i gdung ba sel ba'i chags pa yod pas/ de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du rgyud sde bzhir gsungs/ zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rin po che pas/ gnas skabs bzhi la ltos nas rgyud sde bzhi/ mi rigs bzhi la ltos nas rgyud sde bzhi/ sad pa bzhi la ltos nas rgyud sde bzhi zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams ni/ dus 'khor du bla med bzhir bzhag la/

de'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi de 'dir sbyar kyang mi 'grig go /de ltar rgyud sde bzhi las/ bya ba so so'i rgyud dang / spyi rgyud la sogs pa dang / spyod rgyud kyi rnam gzhag ni/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas spyi rnam gnyis su legs par bkral bas der blta'o/ /rin po che pas/ dang por ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i bdag nyid lhar snyems pa med pa sogs kyi don ni/ bdag lhar bskyed pa dang / ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa med par don la'ang gnas shing / bla ma gong ma rnams dang / dgra nag dang / gur 'grel sogs las kyang gsungs mod kyis/ sangs rgyas gsang ba sogs kyis bdag bskyed dang / ye shes gzhug pa la sogs pa du ma bshad pa ni/ sangs rgyas gsang ba sogs rnam snang mngon byang sogs kyang bya rgyud du bzhed pas/ bya spyod bsres pa la dgongs sam brtag cing / slob dpon gzhan rnams kyis de nyid bsdus par bya spyod kyi cho ga la'ang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sbyar du rung ba la dgongs so/ /dper na sor 'brangs dang / 'od zer can lta bu'i lha dang sngags 'dra ba zhig bya rgyud las 'byung ba ltar/ saṃ ṭi sogs bla med kyi rgyud las kyang 'byung bas/ bla med kyi dgongs pa bkab pa yin nam/ 'on te bya rgyud rang gi dgongs pas kyang bdag bskyed thob pa yin brtag par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ phyis rting don zhags kyi cho ga zhib mo rnam rol du/ bdag bskyed yod par byas nas/ bya ba'i rgyud la'ang bdag bskyed yod par yang bshad/ med par yang bshad pa las/ yod pa don la gnas so/ /ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las med par bshad pa ni/ mnyam gzhag las langs te/ rjes thob kyi gnas skabs su lha'i bsnyems pa med pa la dgongs pa yin no zhes gsungs/ de ni mi 'thad de/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms lha bco lnga'i sgrub thabs las dge ba'i rtsa ba yang rgya cher bsngo'o/ /'phags pa rnams la mchod cing /

bdag las kyi rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ zhes dge ba'i ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba yan chad/ sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rjes la/ de nas rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying khar gtugs te/ badzra atma konyahaṃ/ zhes pas las thams cad pa'i rdo rje rdo rje sems dpar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdor sems kyi nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams byed par bshad pa'i phyir dang / yang slob dpon des bya rgyud la bdag bskyed yod pa'i shes byed du rnam snang mngon byang dang / phyag rdor dbang bskur sogs 'dren pa yin la/ phyag rdor dbang bskur las/ gang tshe byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa/ gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa bdag nyid rang gi lha'i gzugs su byas la/ the tshom med pa'i yid kyis nga rgyal bskyed cing / 'gro yang rung / 'greng yang rung / 'dug kyang rung / rtag tu dus thams cad du bskyod kyang mi g.yo ba de'i tshe zhi ba'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin no zhes 'gro 'dug bsgul bskyod ci byed kyang lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel par/ bdag lha'i skur bskyed pa bshad pa de'i shes byed spyod rgyud rnams drangs pa'i phyir/ spyod rgyud rnams la'ang bya rgyud ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa'i phyir/ bya spyod gnyis rgyud sde gcig tu bzhed pa yin la/ khyed kyi lugs la rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges par byas nas/ bya rgyud las spyod rgyud khyad par du 'phags par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs tshad mar khas len pa dang / dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal med par 'dod pa nang 'gal lo/ /yang kha cig na re/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med par bshad pa'i don ni/ shas che ba'am/

srog rtsol la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnams bsgom mi nus pa'i gang zag la dgongs pa yin la/ rang gi ngo bo bdag bskyed yod pa kho nar/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad la/ yan lag bzhi la sogs pa lha'i rnal 'byor la bya spyod gnyis 'dra la/ rnam snang mngon byang lta bu yang gdul bya'i dbang gis bya rgyud du yang gsungs pas/ bya spyod gnyis gdul bya'i dbang gis 'byed pa ma gtogs rgyud rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas mi 'byed cing / bsam gtan phyi mar sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol zhes pa'i 'grel par/ gzhi ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i rang bzhin no/ /gzhi gnyis pa ni/ rang gi lha'i gzugs so/ /zhes rang lha'i skur byed par bshad la/ 'di bya rgyud du mi 'dod pa yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir bshad pa'i yan lag bzhi dang / rnam snang mngon byang gnyis kyang 'dra bas 'di'i gzhi'i tshig don rang lhar bskyed pa'i gzhi la byar mi rung na/ rnam snang mngon byang gi gzhi ni/ zhes pa'i rkang pa gnyis kyang / rang lhar bskyed pa ma bstan par 'dod dgos te/ khyad par med pa'i phyir ro/ /zer ba yang mi 'thad de/ bdag bskyed med par gsungs pa'i don/ bsam gtan rtse gcig tu bsgom mi nus pa'i gang zag la dgongs pa yin na/ 'o na bya ba'i rgyud yin na bdag nyid lha'i skur bsgom pa med pas ma khyab par thal/ bdag bskyed yod pa don la gnas pa'i phyir/ de 'dod na/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed med par gsungs pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gzhi ngos ma zin pa'am/ yang na drang don du thal ba'i skyon yod do/ /yang bya rgyud kyi gdul bya'i gtso bo bsam gtan rtse gcig tu bsgom mi nus pa rnams yin par 'gyur la/ 'dod na/ gdul bya'i gtso bo la bstan pa'i lam de lam mtshan nyid pa ma yin par thal ba'i skyon yod do/ /rnam snang mngon byang bya rgyud du gsungs pa nyid kyis kyang / bya rgyud la spyod rgyud kyi dbang byas par grub la/

bya spyod gnyis gdul bya'i dbang gis so sor 'byed la/ rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas mi 'byed pa'ang shin tu mi 'thad de/ gdul bya la gsungs pa'i don de rgyud de'i don la mi gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam gtan phyi mar gzhi zhes pa'i don yang / gzhi dang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / gzhi gnyis pa rang sgyu ma tsam du gnas pa'i snying kha'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la'ang bshad du rung ba'i phyir dang / rnam snang mngon byang gi gzhi dang po ni/ rang lhar bskyed pa'i lus dang / gnyis pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sku la gsungs na/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bsam gtan phye ma'i 'grel par/ gzhi zhes pa'i don yang de las zlog nas bshad pas mi 'thad pa yin no/ /yang rang la ye shes pa gzhug pa/ sangs rgyas gsang ba dang byang chub mchog gnyis kas bshad/ ma bshad kyang rgya gar ba gzhan du mas bshad pas rung ste/ de mi rung na/ de'i rgyu mtshan du/ rang dang lha ye shes pa gnyis so sor bzung nas gcig tu 'dzin pa la mi mos pa 'god dgos na/ de ni mi rung ste/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / lha'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par mos pa'i mthus/ lus kyi bsgul bskyod kun phyag rgya dang / ngag tu brjod pa kun sngags su gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes ye shes pa rang la zhugs par 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gzhi ni rang gi lhar bzhag pa/ /rang gi lus la bya ba yin/ /gnyis pa'i gzhi ni zhes bya ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /ces gzhi gnyis pa ye shes pa mdun du zhugs pa la bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te de ni spyod rgyud kyi lugs yin la/ 'di ni bya ba'i rgyud yin pas mi 'dra'o snyam na/ 'o na khyed rang gis rgyud 'di gnyis gdul bya'i dbang gis 'byed pa ma gtogs/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mi 'byed par khas blangs pa dang 'gal lo/ /gzhan yang bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med pa mi 'thad de/

sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lung dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gzhan la skyon du 'phangs nas/ rang gis sangs rgyas gsang ba tshad mar mi 'dod pa'ang nang 'gal ba yin no/ /yang khyed rang gi lugs la rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges shing / bya rgyud las spyod rgyud zab par 'dod pas gong du brjod pa'i skyon gyis kyang gnod do/ /yang phyogs snga ma 'di gnyis pas sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / byang chub mchog gnyis ka bdag bskyed yod pa'i lugs su gcig car bzhed pa mi 'thad de/ byang chub mchog gis/ de bas na 'di ltar khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes rnam par dpyad de/ mtha' dag nam mkha' lta bur bsam nas/ rang gi sems kyi rnam pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur brtas pa/ 'di ni byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yin no/ /de la bzlas pa'i gsang sngags rnams go rim bzhin du bkod pas/ de dag las 'od zer sna tshogs rnams byung zhing / sems can rnams tshim par byas nas/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzugs dang bcas par 'od zer slar log nas/ rang gi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhugs par bsam mo/ /zhes thog mar byang chub kyi sems sgom pa/ de zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsgyur ba/ de la sngags bkod pa/ de las lha'i sku spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar bsdus nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs par bsam pa rnams bshad kyis/ rang lha'i skur bsgom pa sgrub thabs 'di'i gang nas kyang ma gsungs so/ /yang kha cig na re/ spyod rgyud la ye shes pa dgug gzhug byed dgos te/ phyag rdor dbang bskur las/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa zhes sogs gsungs pas/ 'gro 'dug bsgul bskyod la sogs pa bya ba ci byed pa thams cad lha'i nga rgyal gyis byed par bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ro/ /dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bshad pas/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug byed dgos pa la/ spyir 'brel pa med cing /

bye brag tu gang zag gcig gi lugs la dus thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bshad pas/ ye shes pa gzhug pa khas len dgos na/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs la der 'gyur ro/ /des na bya ba'i rgyud kyi nyams len la/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyas bkab dang / yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang byas pa dang / spyod rgyud kyi dbang byas pa dang / bya rgyud rang rkang du bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub dang / dge slong ma dpal mo/ slob dpon tsaṇḍa go mi sogs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnams dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang / phyed dang nyis brgya pa dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho la sgrub thabs nyis brgya dang zhe gnyis tsam yod pa las/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ nor rgyun ma/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs ma gtogs pa rnams yin no/ /de bzhin du slob dpon a bhyas/ phreng bar/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor drug bshad pa las 'byung po 'dul byed/ gzungs grwa lnga/ 'od zer can rnams ni bla med kyi rgyas shan bkab pa yin cing / de'i nang nas kyang lha'i bskyed tshul rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor du bshad pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi nyams len gyi tshul ni/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs te/ phyag mchod dang rgyun bshags byed pa dang / tshad med bzhi bsgoms te/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags kyang byas nas/ srung 'khor ram/ gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du sa bon nam/ cho ga gsum las bdag nyid lhar bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa dgug cing gzhug dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas btab ste yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byed do/ /bla med kyi rgyas bkab byas kyang / dbang bzhi dang / rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor dang / dam tshig gi rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa min mod kyis/ bdag yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi sgo nas lhar bskyed pa'i lam gyi 'gros de sbyar ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid bsdus par/

snying po phyag rgya sngags rigs nas/ /dum bu las bshad rang byas pa'am/ /bsgrub pa 'dis ni thams cad do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ yo gar bshad pa'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor/ chos kyi dkyil 'khor/ las kyi dkyil 'khor dang / bya spyod nas bshad pa'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag rgya dang / sngags kyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rnam dbye so sor shes par byas nas/ dum bu bya spyod gnyis la kho rang nas bshad pa ltar bya ba'am/ yang na de nyid bsdus par bshad pa'i bsgrub pa ste/ rnam snang phyag rgya gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di ni/ bya spyod gnyis ka la'ang sbyar bar shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /sbyor tshul ni/ rnam rgyal lha mang lta bu la sbyar na/ srung 'khor tshogs zhing / gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba/ phyag rgya bcings pa/ spyi'i sngon 'gro/ rdo rje sems dpar bsgom pa rnams spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ mdun du gzhal yas khang bsgom la/ bdag nyid shar gyi sgo khang du gnas te/ gzhal yas khang du rnam rgyal lha so gsum bskyed/ de la ye shes pa gzhug pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab pa rnams byed pa yin no/ /'di lta bu'i cho ga'i gzhung zur du rgya bod gang gis kyang byas pa ma mthong mod kyis/ grub chen kun snying gi rnam snang sgyu dra'i 'grel par/ cho ga 'di bya spyod la sbyor tshul gsal bar gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs kyi bya rgyud kyi bshad tshul lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa med de/ bya rgyud kyi rgyud sde da lta bod na bzhugs pa sum brgya tsam snang ba 'di rnams nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa ston byed kyi tshig gcig kyang ma gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rnam 'joms kyi 'grel pa slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa dang / slob dpon rdo rje go cha'i khrus kyi cho ga la sogs par yang bdag bskyed med par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/de bzhin du rgyud sde gong ma las kyang med par bshad de/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ 'jigs par dmigs shing shin tu gtsang sbra byed pa dang / ye shes sems dpa'i bde ba dam pa med pa dang / bdag nyid lha'i snyem pa med pa dang / rmad du byung ba'i spyod yul ma yin pa dang / skyon gyi rgyu'i rtogs pas rab tu spyad de sgrub par byed pa ni bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du/ grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi 'grel pa dang / rgyal po ant+ri bhu ti'i bde mchog gi 'grel pa dang / slob dpon rgyal ba byin gyi gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa dang / slob dpon dman zhabs kyi gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa rnams su yang bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med par bshad do/ /des na spyod rgyud la bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa yod pa'i sgo nas bya rgyud las zab 'dod do/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la de'ang khyad par du 'phags mod/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas spyan drangs te bdag nyid la gzhug pa dang / phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs kyis dbyer med du bsres te ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa 'dres pa'i bde ba la sems 'dzin pa yod pas khyad par du 'phags par 'dod cing / de gsum gyi lugs la'ang / tshe 'di la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub par byed do/ /rnal 'byor bla med pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du ye shes pa gzhug pa dang / thar pa'i 'dra 'bag lam du byed pa yod pas/ lugs de'ang khyad par du 'phags pa yin mod/ de ltar na'ang ras dri ma can gyi dri ma 'khrud par byed la/ ras kho rang chu ru 'khrud dgos pa ltar/ las dang nyon mongs pas 'phangs pa'i zag bcas kyi phung po nyid 'khor bar 'phen 'dzin byed pa'i gzhi yin pa'i 'di'i steng du skye shi bar do gsum gyi bag chags ji snyed pa gcig bsags pa thams cad sbyang gzhir byas nas de sbyong bar byed pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor 'khor ba'i 'dra 'bag lam du byed pa gcig dgos so zhes 'dod do/

/rgyud sde bzhi la ming gi don ni/ ci'i phyir bya ba'i rgyud ces bya zhe na/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel pa las/ rgyud 'di ni phyi lus ngag gi bya ba gtso bor ston pa bya ba'i rgyud do/ /zhes gsungs/ ci'i phyir spyod pa'i rgyud ces bya zhe na/ lus ngag gi bya ba dang / ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par spyod pa ste/ rnam snang mngon byang gi don bsdus las/ rgyud 'di ni gtsang sbra la sogs pa smad nas/ 'jig rten dang 'gal bar spyod pa gnyis ka la spyod pas spyod pa'i rgyud/ ces gsungs so/ /ci'i phyir rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces bya zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pa'i phyir te/ de nyid snang chen gyi don bsdus las/ rgyud 'di ni ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ces gsungs so/ /ci'i phyir rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud ces bya zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med pa'i phyir te/ phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub sgrub par byed pa la 'di las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyud gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang sambu ṭi las/ gsang ba'i ye shes sogs spyi rnam bzhin no/ /bla med kyi rgyud la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su nges te/ rdo rje gur las/ skyes pa rnams ni gdul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni rgyud bshad do/ /bud med rnams ni gdul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud bshad do/ /zhes dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ /ces dang / phreng ba las/ rnal 'byor pha dang ma rnams kyis/ /zhes gsungs/ zla gsang thig le las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ pha rgyud sde gsum dang / ma rgyud sgo drug tu 'byed tshul ni gzhan du shes so/

/rnal 'byor pha ma gnyis kyi khyad par la rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed pas/ rjod byed tshig gi khyad par/ brjod bya don gyi khyad par/ rjes mthun mtshams kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa la sogs pa yi ge bcu bzhis thog drangs pa'i gleng gzhi'i tshig yod pa rnams pha rgyud/ gsang ba mchog gi la sogs pas thog drangs pa ma rgyud/ he badzra ni/ rtsa rgyud du/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa la sogs pas thog drangs la/ rdo rje gur du/ nam mkha' bem bcas dwangs pa dang / saṃ ṭir/ 'di skad bdag thos dang / gsang ba mchog gi dges pa gnyis ka 'byung bas/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud do/ /gnyis pa brjod bya don gyi khyad par la bskyed rim gyi khyad par/ rdzogs rim gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ lha yab kyis gtso byas shing / yab gtso che ba la 'khor pho tshogs kyis bskor ba thabs kyi rgyud/ yum gtso che zhing 'khor mo tshogs kyis bskor ba shes rab kyi rgyud do/ /gnyis pa ni/ las rgya dang / gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ston pa shes rab kyi rgyud/ phra thig gi rnal 'byor ston pa thabs kyi rgyud do/ /rjes mthun mtshams kyi khyad par ni/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad lha yab kyi rnam par bsgom pa thabs kyi rgyud de 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags/ /rdo rje'i skye mched 'di dag kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /ces gsungs/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad lha mo'i rnam par bsgom pa shes rab kyi rgyud de/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs dang / gzugs la dkar mor rtag tu bshad/ /ces sogs gsungs so/ /rin po che'i lugs la'ang gong ltar gsum las/ dang po ni 'di skad bdag gis thos pa la sogs pa gleng gzhi'i tshig yod pa pha rgyud/ gsang ba mchog gis sogs yod pa ma rgyud/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes sku dang /

nyin byed sku sogs yod pa gnyis med kyi rgyud do/ /yang rgya che ba ston pa thabs/ zab pa ston pa shes rab/ gnyis ka ston pa gnyis med kyi rgyud do/ /gnyis pa brjod bya don gyi khyad par la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'byung ba bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las gzhal yas khang bskyed pa pha'i rgyud de/ gsang 'dus lta bu la bsams so/ /'byung ba bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du bskyed pa ni shes rab kyi rgyud de/ bde mchog lta bu la bsams so/ /de gnyis kyi shugs la dang po 'byung ba bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa bskyed/ de dag ro gcig tu 'dres pa las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni gnyis med kyi rgyud de/ dus 'khor la bsams so/ /nyin mtshan mnyam pa dag pa gtso bo yab yum zhal phyag mnyam pa ston pa pha rgyud de/ gsang 'dus lta bu'o/ /thun tshod snga phyi dag pa gtso bo yab yum zhal phyag mi mnyam pa ston pa ma rgyud de/ bde mchog lta bu'o/ /de gnyis kyi shugs la gtso bo yab yum zhal phyag mi mnyam yang / 'khor rnams zhal phyag mnyam pa ston pa gnyis med kyi rgyud de/ dus 'khor thugs dkyil lta bu'o/ /gang thabs mi g.yo bar gnas shing / shes rab kyi dgug gzhug la sogs pa bya ba byed pa shes rab kyi rgyud/ gang du shes rab mi g.yo bar gnas shing / thabs kyi dgug gzhug la sogs pa'i bya ba byed pa yod pa ni thabs kyi rgyud do/ /gang du 'jig rten pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par ston pa rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi na bza' la sogs pa yod ni pha rgyud/ gang du 'jig rten pa'i spyod pa dang 'gal ba ston pa ro gdan dang / rus pa'i rgyan dang / mi lpags kyi na bza' la sogs pa yod pa ni ma rgyud/ de bzhin du dur khrod yod pa ma rgyud dang / med pa pha'i rgyud do/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi khyad par ni/
