las rgya dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ston pa ma rgyud/ sgyu lus dang 'od gsal ston pa pha rgyud do/ /rjes thun mtshams kyi khyad par ni gong ma dang 'dra'o/ /de thams cad kyang gtso che chung ngam/ phyogs gcig gi dbang du byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rje 'gos kyi lugs la rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ni/ ye shes phab pa'i dus kyi myong ba la sogs pa dbang dus su skyes pa'i ye shes tsam lam du byed pa yin la/ rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud ni zab pa dang / rgya che ba gnyis ka ston pa yin te/ de yang sngon 'gro dben pa gsum gyi rdzogs rim/ dngos gzhi dben pa gnyis kyi rdzogs rim/ mjug zung 'jug pa'i rdzogs rim mo/ /dang po la lus dben sku rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin/ ngag dben gsung rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin/ sems dben thugs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /dang po ni/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje 'chang gcig tu bsgom pa dang / rang gi lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad dam pa rigs brgya'i rnal 'byor du bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum po thams cad rdo rje bzlas par bsgyur te rlung la dbang thob par byed do/ /gsum pa ni/ chos can rig pa dang / chos nyid rig pa gnyis las/ dang po ni las kyi phyag rgya la bsten te bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i sgo nas sems snang mched thob gsum ye shes su sgyur bar byed pa'o/ /ma rgyud pa la 'di man chad kyi lam tsam zhig yod kyi bden pa gnyis kyi rdzogs rim sogs kyi don ni med do/ /kha cig na re/ rus rgyan yod med dang / dur khrod yod med sogs kyis pha rgyud ma rgyud 'jog mi nus pas/ de dag g.yas chung ba yin no/ /gzhan du na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyang ma rgyud du 'gyur te/ dur khrod bshad pas so/ /des na rdzogs rim gyi sgo nas 'jog dgos la/ de yang sgyu lus dang /

'od gsal gyi khyad par du byas pa'i rdzogs rim ston pa pha rgyud/ las rgya dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyi khyad par du byas pa'i rdzogs rim ston pa ma rgyud do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na/ grub chen nag po pa bkag par song ste/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal bar/ rnal 'byor rgyud du de bzhin gshegs/ /'di skad la sogs gang gsungs pa/ /de ni rnal 'byor ma rgyud du/ /gsang ba mchog gis dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'di skad bdag gis thos sogs kyi gleng gzhi'i tshig yod pa pha rgyud yin la/ de'i dod du/ gsang ba mchog gis dgyes pa sogs yod pa ma rgyud du bstan pas/ kyai rdo rje yang pha rgyud du 'gyur ba dang / yang na de nyid la yang gsang ba mchog gis dgyes pa na/ /zhes pa'i gleng gzhi'i tshig yod par 'gyur ro/ /des na lung de'i don/ gsang 'dus la pha rgyud dang / bde mchog la ma rgyud du bzhag ste/ pha rgyud gsang 'dus su/ 'di skad ces sogs kyi don ni/ ma rgyud bde mchog tu/ gsang ba mchog gis dgyes pa na/ /zhes sogs kyi gleng gzhi 'di ni dga' bzhi dang lhan skyes ston cing / de bzhin du 'di skad la sogs pa des kyang de nyid bstan pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /de bzhin du grub chen shaddha'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa las kyang / gang du rgya che ba'i de kho na nyid ston pa ni thabs kyi rgyud do/ /gang du zab pa'i de kho na nyid ston pa ni shes rab kyi rgyud do/ /zhes pa dang / slob dpon dman zhabs kyi gsang 'dus kyi 'grel par yang / gang du rlung gi de kho na nyid ston pa ni thabs kyi rgyud do/ /gang du rtsa'i de kho na nyid ston pa ni shes rab kyi rgyud do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyan drug yod med sogs dang / dur khrod yod med sogs kyis kyang gnas skabs de dang der 'jog nus pa yin te/ pha rgyud nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin gyi rin po che'i rgyan de ma rgyud pa la mi 'byung ba dang /

ma rgyud nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin gyi rus pa'i rgyan de pha rgyud pa la mi 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du dur khrod sogs kyang de bzhin yin no/ /gzhan du na phyogs ma lus pa mtshon nus pa ni khyed rang gi de yang med de/ sgyu lus dang / 'od gsal gyi khyad par du byas pa'i rdzogs rim de gsang 'dus ma gtogs pha rgyud gzhan las mi 'byung bas so/ /'o na 'jigs byed la dur khrod yod pa ji ltar yin snyam na/ de ni pha rgyud pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos su bstan pa ma yin gyis/ drag po'i las bsgrub pa la dgos pa'i dbang du byas nas bstan pa yin te/ dper na gsang 'dus la'ang drag las kyi skabs su dur khrod bstan pa bzhin no/ /rin po che pas 'byung bzhi zhu nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa sogs dang / nyin mtshan mnyam pa dag pa/ thun tshod snga phyi dag pa/ zhes sogs de rnams ni dus 'khor gyi chos skad do/ /'o na thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jog byed gang yin snyam na/ grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rjes/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal bar/ bskyed dang rdzogs 'byung rim pa yis/ /rnal 'byor bskyed par shes bya ste/ /rdzogs pa rnal 'byor ma ru dran/ /zhes gsungs pas rgyud sde gang du rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan kyang rung / ma bstan kyang bskyed pa'i rim pa dngos bstan la yod pa ni rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud dang / rgyud sde gang du bskyed rim skye shi bar do gsum sbyang gzhir byas nas/ de sbyong nus pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor bstan pa'am/ ma bstan kyang rung ste/ de dang dod thub nges shes pa zhig bstan pa'i steng du/ rdzogs rim dngos su bstan pa de ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud do/ /de'ang rgyud kyi dum bu la ni ma nges so/ /'o na gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyis kyang / rdzogs rim dngos su ma bstan nam snyam na/ las kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid dang / de sbyang brtag byed pa'i thabs dngos su bstan med/

de ni sbas pa la/ kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sbas pa/ sems gsum gyi sbas pa/ 'dod chags chos kyi sbas pa gsum gyi bskyed rim la 'dod chags chos sbas kyi bshad pa byas pas ston pa yin no/ /gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor gyi rgyud rnams grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis bla med du bsgrub pa la/ dbang bzhi yod pa la bsgrub dgos byung zhing / dbang bzhi ston byed kyi tshig kyang dgra nag las/ cod pan dbang bskur dang po ste/ /ral gri'i dbang bskur gnyis pa yin/ rdo rje dril bu rab sbyor ba/ /zla ba btung ba bzhi pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / rgyal mtshan can gyi khyams mthong nas/ /de nas 'o ma bsgrub par bya/ /zhes pa las gzhan ma rnyed pas/ rdzogs rim zab mo gcig ston par khas blangs kyang dka' ba yin no/ /rgyas par 'jigs byed kyi zin bris su blta'o/ /'o na kyai rdo rje'i rgyud pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gang yin snyam na/ ma'i rgyud yin te/ brtag gnyis kyi mjug tu/ brtag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid kyai rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'byung zhing / de'i skad dod la/ ṭā ki ni dzwa la saṃ bha ra zhes pa yod la/ ṭā ki ni mkha' 'gro ma dang / saṃ ni bde ba/ bha ra ni sdom pa dang / mchog gang du bsgyur kyang chog pas/ mkha' 'gro ma bde mchog gi rgyud ces par bsgyur cing / le'u bzhi par/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams he ru ka'i gzugs kyis/ zhes pa'i 'grel par/ dag ldan du/ he ru ka'i gzugs kyis zhes bya ba ni rgyud 'di mkha' 'gro ma bde mchog gi rgyud yin pas/ rgyud 'dir khro chags kyi sku'i rnam pa 'di gtso bor gyur pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rje btsun rin po che'i bzhed pa la/ bde mchog la/ 'khor lo bde mchog sgyu ma bde mchog kyai rdor bde mchog ste gsum las/ 'dir kyai rdor bde mchog tu bzhed pa yin no/

/yang sangs rgyas nyid kyis rdo rje gur las/ mkha' 'gro bde dang rgya mtsho'i bde dang nam mkha' dang / /dga' chen za nus dang ni gsang ba'i yid bde dang / /bde chen sgeg pa dang ni gser gyis chags pa dang / /rgyud brgyad phan par byed pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang / /gsang ba mdzod dang rdo rje bdud rtsi 'byung ba dang / /'khor lo sdom pa gur gyi 'byung gnas ni/ /rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud sgo drug par ni grags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dam tshig tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro lnga ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud bshad do/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga po la mkha' 'gro ma'i ming gis gsungs pa dang chos nyan du yod pa'i 'khor rnams ngo mtshar skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das la sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pa'i lan du/ ngas btags pa ma yin gyis/ 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams na rdo rje nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po yod pas/ de'i nang nas ṭāai bāe ha ya sa ga ma ṇe zhes bya ba'i sgra las/ thams cad kun tu nam mkhar spyod pa grub pas 'di ni mkha' 'gro mar rab tu grags so/ /zhes mkha' 'gro ma'i sgras gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang lugs 'di la tshad ma'i skyes bur gyur pa grub chen ḍombhi bas/ bdud rtsi 'od du/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyai rdo rje las zhes pa dang / ku mu tir/ kyai rdo rje lha mo'i rgyud/ /snying po'i tshogs kyis/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyud rgyas pa'i lung rdo rje snying 'grel du drangs par/ rnal 'byor ma ni kun spyod cing / /gang du thabs ni nges gnas pa/ /kun rdzob rnal 'byor ma rgyud du/ /byis pa rnams la nga yis bstan/ /gang du thabs ni kun spyod cing / /shes rab gnas par gyur pa nyid/

/kun rdzob thabs kyi rgyud ces par/ /gang yin de ni nga yis bstan/ /shes rab thabs ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /kyai rdo rje ni phyogs gcig min/ /don gyi 'dus pa la sogs kun/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gang du thabs te/ lha yab mi g.yo bar gnas shing / shes rab gau rī la sogs pa rnams kyis dgug pa dang / gzhug pa la sogs pa'i bya ba byed pa ni kun rdzob ste/ drang don du rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du/ byis pa rnams la nga yis bstan/ /ces pa dang / gang du shes rab ste/ lha mo rnams mi g.yo bar gnas shing / thabs tho ba gshin rje gshed dang / dbyug pa gshin rje gshed la sogs pa rnams kyis dgug gzhug sogs kyi bya ba byed pa ni kun rdzob ste/ drang don du thabs rgyud du bstan/ ces 'byung pas kyang kye rdor ma rgyud du grub bo/ /de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis nges pa'i don du na/ kyai rdo rje ni/ thabs shes rab snyoms par 'jug pa de nyid kyi phyir na/ thabs phyogs gcig pa yang min/ shes rab phyogs gcig pa yang min gyis/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med par bstan pa'i rgyud do/ /de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis ni kyai rdo rjer ma zad/ gsang 'dus sogs bla med kyi rgyud thams cad kyang / nges don du gnyis su med pa'i rgyud do zhes pa'o/ /drang don dang nges don du de ltar yin par yang kun rdzob tu zhes pa dang / don gyis zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pa las shes so/ /de la yang kyai rdo rje ma rgyud gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul/ khyad par 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis aṣṭa'i gzhi bshad du/ dang por gso sbyong nas/ de rjes kyai rdo rje bstan/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ skal dman rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshe yang / lam snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma zab par bstan pa yin zhing / kyai rdo rje kun gyi mjug tu bstan pas so/ /skal ldan gcig char du 'jug pa'i tshe na yang /

dang por gsang sngags la 'jug sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai rdo rje bstan/ /ces pas kyai rdo rje gsang sngags kun gyi mjug tu bstan pas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des kyang bstan mod/ de ltar na yang / thams cad rig byed grub mtha' dang / /de bzhin las rgyas la sogs pas/ /srid pa dag 'gyur dngos grub min/ /yang ni srid mthar skye bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /de med pas na dngos grub med/ /gang gis mi shes kyai rdo rje/ /de yi ngal ba don med 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'dis gsal bar bstan pa yin te/ de la thams cad rig byed ces pa ni phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi grub mtha' bzhi dang / grub mtha' dang zhes pa ni/ rang gi sde pas brtags pa'i grub mtha' dang / las rgyas zhes pas ni/ zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang la sogs pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor rnams dang / des mtshon nas thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub par byed pa'i thabs ston pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor rnams kyis skye ba 'di la srid pa dag 'gyur te/ zad par 'gyur ba'i dngos grub mi thob ste/ skye ba phyi mar yang srid par skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten 'di dang zhes pa ni mchog gi dngos grub thob na thun mong gi dngos grub de'i zhar la 'byung bas 'di dang zhes pa'o/ /gal te bde mchog rtsa rgyud du yang / gang gis 'khor lo bde mchog mi shes pa/ /de ni rmongs pa phub ma brdungs dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa dang / dgra nag las/ 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du rgyud thams cad du yang / rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes pa ma gtogs/ 'di blon po yin zhes pa dang 'di mi zab ces mi 'byung bas/ rgyud kyi che ba brjod pa tsam yin no zhe na/ che ba brjod pa zhes pa'i don/ don la gnas pa gcig la de ltar zer ba yin nam/ don la mi gnas kyang /

de bzhin gshegs pas bstod ra mdzad zer ba yin/ dang po ltar na kho bo cag gi 'dod pa grub la/ gnyis pa ltar na/ de bzhin gshegs pas rdzun gsungs zer bar song bas mi 'thad do/ /de ltar na/ rgyud thams cad du'ang rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes 'byung ba la thun mong ma yin pa'i go rgyu re re yod de/ dper na gshin rje gshed skor du rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes 'byung ba ni/ 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las bsgrub pa la rgyud 'di las myur ba med ces bya ba'i don to/ /myur ba yang yin te/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud du las tshogs ston pa la le'u gsum tsam gsungs mod/ de sgrub par byed pa la/ dang por sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la slob/ de nas dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus shing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas par byed/ de nas theg pa gsar pa dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la slob/ de nas rtog pa'i rnal 'byor phra thig la slob/ de nas sgrub pa las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor te/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa zla ba drug tu spyod de/ de nas las tshogs rnams bsgrub par gsungs kyi de las gzhan du mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dus 'khor du las chen bcu gnyis gsungs pa de bsgrub pa la/ dbang dang bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor sngon du song nas/ rdzogs rim la sor bsdud dang / bsam gtan sgom la/ srog gzugs grub pa ste/ srog rtsol gyi rnal 'byor/ rlung la dbang thob thob kyi bar du bsgoms nas las tshogs rnams bsgrub na 'grub kyis/ gzhan du ci yang mi 'grub pa dang / de bzhin du brtag gnyis las/ rdo rje gri gug gi las sbyor bshad pa ni/ he ru ka'i lder so bzhugs pa'i lha khang gi nang du phyin nas/ lder bzo'i zhal du kha ṭi ka'i ril bu bcug nas sgrub pa byas pas/ lder bzos gsung byon nas ril bu lag tu ma gtad kyi bar du sgrub pa byed dgos pa sogs gnyug bud bud kyi bar du bsgrub dgos la/

'dir ni bsnyen pa sngon du song nas dbang po rnon pos bsam gtan tsam gyis 'grub cing / 'bring pos de'i steng du 'khrul 'khor dang / tha mas kyang de'i steng du sbyin sreg gi sgo nas nges par 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na kyai rdo rje 'di ma rgyud gzhan las zab pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ spyir chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de ma rtogs par bla na med pa'i byang chub mi thob pa ni/ theg pa chen po spyi'i lugs yin la/ stong nyid de rtogs byed kyi thabs mang du gsungs kyang / thabs rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa myur du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs ni rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin yin la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa de nyid rgyud 'dir rgyas pa dang / gsal bar bstan pa yin te/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i rgyu/ zhu bde dngos su 'dren pa'i thabs/ rlung dang gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang / las rgya la sogs pa rgyud 'dir gsal bar bstan pa tsam zhig rgyud gzhan du ma bstan pa'i phyir/ /'o na gsang 'dus rim lnga sogs kyang yod pa ma yin nam snyam na/ yod mod kyis/ de ni rdo rje 'chang nas/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi bar la snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdam ngag yin gyis/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan las mi thon no/ /de bzhin du dril bu rim lnga/ nag po rim bzhi sogs kyang rdo rje 'chang nas grub chen dril bu pa la sogs pa de dang de'i bar du snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yin gyis/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan las 'byung ba ma yin no/ /gnyis pa la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud gnyis so/ /dang po la/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa dang / der ma zad 'bum phrag bdun pa'ang yod de/ rdo rje gur las/ 'bum phrag lnga yi rgya mtsho che/

/'bum phrag lnga pa'i mtshan zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis rdzogs ldan gyi dus kyi gdul bya rnams la gsungs pa yin te/ de rnams bsod nams che zhing / tshe ring ba dang shes rab che bas/ gzhung yi ger 'bri bar yang nus shing / thos bsam byed par yang nus/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par yang nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud rgyas pa de gang na bzhugs snyam na/ rin po che pa na re/ tsanda mdar byed kyi gling na bzhugs gsungs pa ni mi 'thad de/ rdzogs ldan gyi dus kyi gdul bya rnams la rgyud rgyas pa de gsungs nas/ rtsod dus kyi gdul bya rnams la mkho ba'i yul du ma gyur bas/ de rnams mi snang bar byin gyis brlabs pa yin te/ shānti pa'i dgra nag gi 'grel par/ de bas na bsam gtan gyi bdud rtsi'i ro ma myang bas/ thos pa dang bsam pa'i shes rab tsam la chags bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byed par ma gyur cig snyam du dgongs pas/ ched du gzhung rgyas pa mi snang bar byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /de'i don yang / sngags la zhugs pa'i dgos pa ni bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i ched yin la/ rtsod dus kyi sems can rnams kyis gzhung de rnams yi ger yang 'bri mi nus pa dang / thos bsam gyis dus 'das nas tshe'i dus byed par 'gyur snyam du dgongs nas mi snang bar byin gyis brlabs zhes pa'o/ /de ltar na rdo rje'i gnas chen u rgyan la sogs pa na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi phyag na bzhugs pa rnams ni ma bkag mod kyis/ snod kyi 'jig rten gcig thun mong du snang ba la las mthun par bsags pa'i 'gro ba mi la sogs pa rnams kyi mthun snang du grub par snang ba ni med do/ /bstan bcos rnams su 'di'i lung drangs pa yang nyung zhing / rdo rje snying 'grel stod 'grel du drangs pa ni/

rgyud zhu ba po yin pa nyid kyi yin la/ smad 'grel du drangs pa ni/ smad 'grel rtsom pa po de nyid kyis shambha la lta bu'i rdo rje'i gnas chen gcig tu gzigs par gsal lo/ /'phags yul gyi paṇḍi ta rnams kyis lung cung zad drangs pa yang / khong rang gi bla ma grub thob rnams kyi gsung las byung ba bris pa yin gyis/ rtsa rgyud kyi glegs bam gzigs nas bris pa ni ma yin no/ /rtsa rgyud bsdus pa ni brtag pa gnyis pa ste/ de yang ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag tshe thung zhing / shes rab chung ba dbang po brtul pa rnams kyis rtsa rgyud rgyas pa rnams gzung bar mi nus pas de dag gi don du gsungs pa yin no/ /dgos pa ni gur las/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na spros pa las bsdus pa lags/ skal ba bzang po las so so skye bo rnams tshe thung bar gyur na/ ji ltar de rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ ji ltar na sems dpar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na skye bo phal pa tshe thung bar 'gyur/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ re zhig gang dang slob dpon rnams su gyur pa de rnams rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'byung ba 'gyur ba dang / gang dag spyod pa po de rnams mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la spyod par 'gyur ba dang / gang dag so so'i skye bo de dag srog chags gsod par 'gyur ba dang / gang dag ma mo'i tshogs rnams gcig tu 'dod pa la zhen par 'gyur bas te/ de'i phyir rgyud rnams kyi bstan pa rgyas pa ma yin no/ /de la rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa las byung ba yin nam/ rgyud logs pa yin zhe na/ pham thing pa la sogs pa kha cig rgyud logs pa yin te/ rgyud rgyas pa brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ de'i 'og ma brtag pa bcu gnyis pa/ de'i 'og ma brtag pa dgu pa/ chung ba brtag pa gnyis pa 'di'o zhes zer ro/ /de ni yang dag pa ma yin te/ 'di nyid las/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu ma'i brtag pa zhes bya ba brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis pa las byung ba zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/

/rngog pa rnams kyi lugs la/ rgyud rgyas pa'i brtag po dang po gnyis phyung ba yin te/ gur las/ rdo rje snying po mngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po ste/ /sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis pa yin/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'di nyid las kyang / rdo rje snying po mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / sgyu ma'i brtag pa zhes bya ba ming mthun pa'i phyir dang / rgyud kyi thog mar 'byung ba'i gleng gzhi yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bzhed do/ /de ni mi rigs te/ le'u bcu gcig pa las/ gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par/ /rgyas par bshad pa mdo ru bsdus/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal te/ brtag pa 'di'i gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis pa ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gong ma'i rgyud kyi chog rim pas/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil gong ma bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal te/ 'di'i gong du mchod pa'i brtag pa ma song ba'i phyir ro/ /yang 'di rgyud rgyas pa'i brtag pa dang po gnyis phyung ba mi 'thad de/ de yin na 'dir gleng bslangs pa rgyas par 'byung bar rigs pa las ma byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de la kho na re/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa nged rang gnyis kar gyis ma mthong bas shes byed du mi rung la/ gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par/ /zhes pa ni/ le'u bcu gcig pa'i gong bcu pa nas yar bgrangs te/ le'u dang po la bcu pa dang / de nas mar bgrangs te/ dang po la bcu gcig pa/ gnyis pa la bcu gnyis par byas pa'i gnyis par/ ku ru kulle'i sngags bshad pa de/ le'u bcu gcig par mdo ru bsdus pa yin no/ /zhe na de lta bu'i bgrang lugs mkhas pa'i grangs su yang ma song zhing / le'u gnyis par/ oṃ ku ru kulle hri swāhā/ ku ru kulle'i sngags so/ /zhes pa las ma bshad la/ le'u bcu gcig par shlauka phyed dang bzhi tsam bshad pas/ rgyas par bshad pa mdo ru bsdus/ /zhes pa dang 'gal zhing / brtag pa dang le'u khyad par ma phyed par zad do/

/le'u'i skad dod la/ pa ri tshe dha zhes pa dang / brtag pa'i skad dod la/ kal pa zhes 'byung ngo / /yang rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'o skol gnyis kyis ma mthong yang / rdo rje snying 'grel du lung drangs par gsal lo/ /de ni ming bzang yin zhes smras zin pas mi rtsi'o zhe na/ de la yang mi rtsi yang / sambhu ṭi la rtsi dgos shing / saṃ ṭi las gleng bslangs pa rgyas pa 'byung la/ rtsa rgyud rgyas par gleng bslangs pa rgyas par ma gsungs pa bshad rgyud du 'byung ba mi 'thad pas so/ /ming mthun pa tsam yang rgyu mtshan du mi rung ste/ 'di nyid kyi brtag pa dang po las/ le'u bzhi pa dang bcu pa gnyis ka la dbang gi le'u zhes btags kyang / de gnyis gcig ma yin pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na 'di 'bum phrag lnga pa la brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa'i phyi ma gnyis phyung ba yin te/ gur las/ brtag pa sum cu pa yang bshad/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/ /dag pa'i snying pos yongs bsdus pa/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros gsungs pa ste/ /'di ni rgyud kyi nges pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas 'bum phrag lnga pa'i brtag pa sum cu pa yan gsungs tshar nas/ de'i rjes la rdo rje snying po la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams dang / rdo rje bdag med ma la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du/ dag pa'i snying po ste brtag pa sum cu pa yan gyi don de brtag pa gnyis su bsdus nas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro kyai rdo rjes gsungs pa ste/ 'di ni rgyud kyi nges pa'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /mjug tu rdzas sbyor dang / rjes su yi rang gi mdo bstan pa la shlau ka nyer bdun yod pa ma phyung ba yin no/ /des na rtsa rgyud du song ste/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa'i brtag pa phyi ma gnyis phyung bas so/ /bsdus pa'i rgyud du yang song ste/ brtag pa sum cu pa yan gyi don bsdus pa yin pas so/ /'o na 'di'i thog mar gleng gzhi'i tshig 'byung ba mi rigs so snyam na/

rtsa rgyud bsdus pa 'di ni 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di nyid kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gzhan ma yin pa la/ slar yang bzlas te gsungs pa yin la/ de dus su gleng gzhi gsungs pa bka' bsdus pa pos bsdud pa yin te/ dka' 'grel la rdo rje'i tshig btu bar/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi sprul pa'i sku yis lo brgyad cur 'dzam bu'i gling du bzhugs pa de srid la/ rgyud rin po che 'di ni yang nas yang du ma gsungs kyis/ dus gcig na gsungs pa kho na ste/ de bas na 'di'i dus ni dus gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal na re/ rje btsun gong ma dang / rngog pa rnams kyis brgal lan gyi sgo nas ji tsam zhig gtan la phab kyang / da dung ma phebs te/ rje btsun 'brog mi rgyud kyi don la shin tu mkhas kyang / nged rang tshos shes pa'i sgra tsam mi shes pas lan te/ ji ltar bshad kyang / brtag pa bcu gnyis par/ ku ru kulle gsungs zhes 'byung la/ de ltar na rdo rje gur las mkha' 'gro ku ru kulle dgu /ku ru kulle khri gsum gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /des na/ rgyas par brtag pa bcu gnyis kyi/ /snga mar gsungs pa mdo ru bsdus/ /zhes par bsgyur rgyu yin te/ 'di brtag pa so gcig pa yin la/ de nas yar bgrangs pa'i brtag pa bcu gnyis pa tshan pa gnyis kyi snga ma de brtag pa dgu par 'ong bas so/ /zhes zer ro/ /de dag ni sngar brtag pa dgu par ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil 'khor gsungs la/ de ston pa la shlauka khri tsho gsum dang / brtag pa bcu gnyis dngos grub kyi brtag par/ ku ru kulle la brten pa'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sna tshogs gsungs pa/ le'u bcu gcig pa 'dir dbang gi las tsam du bsdus te ston pa/ pu hrang pa gsal ba'i snying po la sogs pas gsungs zin to/ /khyed rang gi de ni tshig tsam la yang dpyad pa ma zhugs par zad de/

bcu pa gnyis yin na nyi shu dang / bcu gnyis pa yin na/ bcu gnyis kyi snga mar gsungs zhes pa dang 'gal lo/ /yang rngog pa rnams dang / rdo rje dpal sogs kha cig na re/ mjug tu shlauka nyer bdun yang ma tshang ba ma yin te/ rgyud kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du/ e waṃ zhes pa dang / a ka ro zhes pa dang / ze'u 'bru la a'i rnam pa zhes pa ste rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon byed kyi rang bzhin a yig gsum gyis rgyas btab pas so/ /dper na mtshan brjod la/ thog mtha' bar gsum du a yig gsum gyis rgyas btab pas mgo mjug tshang ba bzhin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa bshad rgyud la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sambhu ṭi ste/ rgyal po int+ra bhu ti'i 'grel par/ rgyud sde 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug gi bshad rgyud du bshad la/ bu'i ṭikkar rgyud sde sum cu so gnyis dang sbyar/ rje btsun rtse mos rgyud sde bcu drug gam/ bcu bdun la dngos su phan par bshad do/ /de ltar na'ang gsang 'dus dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi dang / bde mchog rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ba rnams kyi bshad rgyud du gtso bor 'gro ste/ de rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' gsal bar byed pas so/ /snga rabs kyi yo ga ba 'ga' zhig gis/ rdor dbyings kyi mngon byang de saṃ ṭi nas bstan par 'dod pa la/ rin po che pa na re/ rang yo ga ba rnal 'byor rgyud bor nas rgyud gzhan bla med kyi mngon byang len pa slob dpon mi mkhas pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ni bla med kyi rgyud nas yo ga'i mngon byang len pa mi 'thad snyam du bsams pa yin mod/ de ltar na phyag rdor 'byung po 'dul byed dang / 'od zer can sogs bya rgyud kyi bshad rgyud du 'gro ba yang dka' zhing / sambhu ṭi de nyid bsdus pa'i bshad rgyud du 'gro ba yang gang gis 'jog dpyad dgos so/ /grub chen mtsho skyes dang /

shānti ba sogs kyi lam srol de la sambhu ṭi bshad rgyud du mi dgos kyang / grub chen birwa pa'i lugs kyi lam 'bras kyi man ngag de rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis nas thon pa la/ saṃ ṭi bshad rgyud du dgos pa yin no/ /rdo rje gur ni rgyud gsung ba po kyai rdo rje dang / chos nyan pa po rnams kyang gur rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor la bkod pa'i lha rnams yin zhing / 'di nas bshad pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor yang kyai rdo rje kho na yin pas/ kyai rdo rje'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud yin zhing / rgya bod gnyis na 'di kyai rdo rje'i bshad rgyud du mi 'dod pa su yang med do/ /bzhugs tshul ni/ saṃ ṭir/ thog mar rgyu rgyud/ de nas thabs rgyud/ de nas 'bras bu'i rgyud rnams go rim bzhin bstan pa ni/ gdul byas lam nyams su len tshul gyi dbang du byas la/ gur du le'u go rim dkrugs nas bstan pa ni/ gang zag shes rab can du rlom pa kha cig slob dpon la ma ltos par rang rgyud la rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i ched yin no/ /brtag pa gnyis la rtsa rgyud dang / 'di gnyis la bshad rgyud du 'jog pa ni thog mar byung zhing / bshad gzhir gyur pa dang / rjes la byung zhing 'chad byed du gyur pas so/ /bshad rgyud du 'gro ba'i tshul la drug ste/ mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa dang / ma tshang ba tshang ba kha skong bas dang / cha mthun pa dang / tshul mi 'dra ba dang / tshig don gyi cha rnam par 'grel par byed pa dang / don bsdus te ston pas na bshad rgyud do/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud du/ gang zhig dbang gi rab phye ba/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor cho gas sbyin/ /zhes pa 'byung yang / bum dbang bskur lugs gsal bar ma bshad pa la/ gur las/ sa chog nas brtsams te rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi bar rnams gsal bar bshad pas des gsal bar byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud du ming dbang bskur ba la rdo rje'i ming 'dogs pa ma tshang ba gur du rigs lnga po la rol pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i ming rnams bshad pas des kha skong ngo /

/cha mthun pa ni/ rtsa rgyud du/ lha mo thams cad kha dog nag /drag chen phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /zhes pa 'byung zhing / gur du/ lha mo thams cad kha dog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa zhes don gcig nyid tshig mi 'dra bar bstan pa dang / sambhu ṭir/ lha mo kha dog sna tshogs mdog /ces nang gi khams kyi dbang gis phyi'i kha dog kyang dkar dmar sna tshogs su bstan pa dang / gtso bo yang zhal gcig phyag bzhi mar bshad pa lta bu'o/ /'o na cha mthun pa dang / tshul mi 'dra ba tsam gyis bshad rgyud du ji ltar 'gyur snyam na/ nges pa bskyed pa'i sgo nas 'gyur te/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gcig nyid la/ 'di lta bu'i tshul mi 'dra ba yang 'dug snyam du nges pa bskyed nus pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ rtsa rgyud du/ mi phyed ma dang / zhes sogs ming tsam bshad pa dang / gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /zhes sogs ming tsam gsungs pa la/ saṃ ṭir/ mi phyed ma ni spyi bor gnas/ /so dang sen mo 'bab par brjod/ /ces sogs dang / gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med/ /zhing na 'od byed gsum pa yin/ /zhes bshad pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa ni/ brtag gnyis las/ spyod pa rgyas par gsungs pa ste/ gur las bsdus te gsungs pa lta bu dang / yang rdo rje snying po mngon par byang chub pa la sogs pa rgyud rgyas pa'i tshig dang don mdor bsdus pa lta bu'o/ /yang sa skya pa phyi ma rnams kyis/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud che ba gsum/ chung ba gsum zhes pa'i brda chad byed do/ /che ba gsum ni gong gi de'o/ /chung ba gsum ni a ra li skor gsum ste/ badzra a ra li/ rigs kyi/ dpal rnyog pa med pa dang gsum mo/ /'di gsum ni rje btsun ga ya dha ras/ siṅga la'i gling gi rnal 'byor ma gcig la gsan cing / de'ang grub chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug las brgyud pa yin no/ /'di gsum kyai rdo rje'i rgyud du 'jog pa ni/

dpal rnyog pa med pa las/ kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil bstan pa dang / rigs kyi a ra li las sku kyai rdo rje bstan cing / sngags kyang / trai lokya akṣe bhya bstan 'dug pas 'jog pa dang / rdo rje a ra li gzhan gnyis ni grogs stobs kyis 'jog pa yin pa 'dra/ gzhan shes byed mi snang ngo / /yang kyai rdo rje las 'phros pa'i rgyud/ thig le skor lnga zhes pa 'byung ste/ phyag rgya chen po thig le/ ye shes snying po/ ye shes thig le/ de kho na nyid kyi sgron me/ grub pa nges bstan thig le'o/ /'di rnams rin po che'i lugs la/ brtag gnyis las 'phros pa'i rgyud du 'dod de/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ de'i rgyud/ phyi ma phyag chen thig le/ phyi ma'i phyi ma ye shes thig le/ snying po'i rgyud ye shes snying po/ de kho na nyid kyi rgyud/ de kho na nyid sgron che/ 'bras bu'i rgyud ni/ grub pa nges bstan thig le'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sa skya pa'i dge bshes phyi ma 'ga' zhig na re/ 'di rnams kyai rdo rje'i rgyud yin byas na yang ma bde/ min byas na yang mi bde ste/ min byas na/ 'di rnams nas kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs kyi brda chad mang po bshad 'dug pa dang / yin byas na ni/ rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud gang yin dka' bar snang ste/ rtsa rgyud rgyas bsdus gnyis gang yang ma yin zhing / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud gang yang min pas so/ /zer ba 'di cung zad rtog pa zhugs par snang ngo / /rtsa rgyud rgyas pa dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs shing / thig le skor lnga'ang de nyid kyi rtsa rgyud kyi rjes la gsungs pa yin te/ int+ra bhu ti'i lung bstan sogs so/ /'di rnams ni rtsa rgyud rgyas pa las 'phros par snang ste/ phyag chen thig ler/ ye shes rgya mtsho kyai rdo rje/ /de ni gtso bo rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /gang zhig khyod kyis de nyid bshad/ /sbyor drug rnal 'byor ma yi gzhung /

/gtso bo chen pos bshad du gsol/ /zhes sogs 'byung bas so/ /des na rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag bdun pa las lnga pa phyung ba yin la/ de'i rgyud phyi ma phyag rgya chen po thig le yin zhing / de'i phyi ma'i phyi ma ye shes snying po/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud ye shes thig le/ snying po'i rgyud grub pa nges bstan thig le/ rgyud de rnams nyams su blangs pa las/ 'bras bu sku gsum thob tshul sogs ni/ de kho na nyid sgron mas bstan te/ ye shes thig le las/ de nas gzhan nyon bdag gis bshad/ /ji ltar rgyud kyi rim pa bzhugs/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i rigs chen rgyud/ /'bum bdun gyis ni mtshan zhes bya/ /de nas gtso bo rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /sku brgyad bdag nyid rab kyi mchog /de bstan kyai rdo rje ni/ /'bum lnga yis ni mtshan zhes bya/ /dpal ldan phyag rgya chen thig le/ /de yi phyi ma'i rgyud du dran/ /ye shes snying por grags pa'i rgyud/ /de yi phyi ma'i phyi ma yin/ /dga' mo ye shes thig le'i sgra/ /bshad pa'i rgyud ni gsang ba che/ /grub pa nges bstan thig le ni/ /zhal bzang mo de snying po dang / /de kho na nyid sgron ma'i mtshan/ /'bras bu'i rgyud grags 'chad par 'gyur/ /de bdun du ni bdag gis bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen kun dga'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i/ gsungs/ bzhin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel phyir dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ zin bris bgyis/ /zhes pa dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud 'chad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag la nye bar mkho ba'i legs bshad/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsung la chos rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i gsung rab ngo mtshar can gyi ma dpe tshig sna ring thung sogs cung zad mi 'dra ba gsum la phan tshun 'dra bsdur gyi sgo nas zhus dag bgyis pa'i legs par bshad pa blo gsal mig thur zhes bya ba 'di yang /
